items.description: 同一任务同时出现在桌面、网页或终端时，需要明确状态由哪一层维护、执行由哪一层负责。梳理不同入口共享的任务信息和各自职责，并核对它们的一致性，避免多个界面逐渐维护出互相冲突的工作版本。

items.title: 梳理任务信息的处理位置
items.description: 桌面界面展示的工作，可能涉及另一个服务边界中的数据或执行。参考 ZCode 项目说明和源码，区分哪些在本地、哪些在远端，以及各部分背景由哪个组件接收。将这张路径图用于自己的工作空间设计，再决定资料范围和批准怎样伴随执行过程。

faq.question: ZCode 是否包含 Agent Harness？
faq.answer: 包含。官方将 ZCode 定位为编程 Agent Harness，仓库除应用代码外也包含 Agent CLI 与运行时，并非仅用于展示模型接口的界面。

faq.question: ZCode 只有桌面应用吗？
faq.answer: 不是。仓库介绍桌面、浏览器和终端入口。应分别核对所选入口的要求，不能假设一种入口的配置可以原样应用到另一种。

faq.question: ZCode 官方仓库属于谁？
faq.answer: 官方仓库为 Z.ai 组织下的 zai-org/ZCode。同名工作台或社区分支应注明各自维护者与改动，不能当作同一官方发行版。

faq.question: 源码许可覆盖哪些内容？
faq.answer: 仓库采用 Apache-2.0。第三方声明、模型 API、托管服务和发行版相关条件仍需单独核对，仓库的 NOTICE.md 提供了相关项目声明。

faq.question: 只看模型能力就能判断 ZCode 效果吗？
faq.answer: 不能。工具配置、上下文组织、执行环境和修改审阅方式都会影响结果，应结合完整任务流程比较，不能以模型名称代替实际效果。

faq.question: 借鉴这些机制是否需要更换工作工具？
faq.answer: 不需要。可以先将 ZCode 作为任务结构、工具边界和结果审阅的设计参考，在已有工作流中验证思路。软件复用是另一项选择，需要核对兼容性、权限与许可；借鉴设计思路不会自动完成软件与 Floatboat 的连接。

prerequisites.title: 核对 ZCode 数据边界
prerequisites.description: 本地与远程执行可能将任务信息交给不同接收方。以下条件结合 ZCode 源码和项目说明确认这些边界，再提供材料；实际服务路径需要单独核对，不能只根据桌面界面判断。

items.title: 检查数据与执行边界
items.description: 结合项目声明与源码评估本地、远程以及接收任务资料的服务边界。

howTo.title: 用 ZCode 验证一条审阅流程
howTo.description: 同一任务跨越界面和工具时，上下文与执行职责需要保持清楚。先验证一个完整、可审阅的结果，再判断哪里值得增加入口或能力，避免扩展过程把任务状态拆散。

items.title: 梳理任务层次
items.description: 区分业务背景、用户交互、执行工具和需要审阅的结果。

items.title: 验证审阅循环
items.description: 先验证一个任务从输入到可审阅结果的完整过程，再扩展工具与交互入口。

zh.seoDescription: 了解 ZCode 编程工作台与运行层的分工，研究任务背景、工具执行和人工审阅怎样衔接，区分交互界面、Harness 与模型服务，为多步骤工作流选择可参考的机制。

en.seoTitle: Ponytail: Reuse-First Coding Rules, Reviews, and Agent Plugins
en.description: Ponytail adds reuse-first coding instructions, change review, and repository audits to existing agents. Explore how its rules can reduce unnecessary implementation while keeping tests, security, and accessibility in the workflow.
overview: Ponytail is DietrichGebert’s open-source instruction set for coding agents. Its main Skill and compact AGENTS.md rules ask an agent to understand the affected code before choosing a solution. Existing repository code, standard libraries, platform features, and installed dependencies are considered before a new implementation.

The project also provides change review, repository auditing, and a ledger for deferred shortcuts. Native plugins and instruction-file adapters load the same underlying approach into different hosts, but commands and lifecycle hooks depend on the host. Ponytail supplies working instructions; the host still provides the model, tools, and execution loop.

For work organized in Floatboat, its useful contribution is a concrete method for controlling implementation scope and reviewing consequences beyond a diff. Apply the method to one repository task and compare the result against your acceptance criteria. The project’s own benchmark results are bounded experiments, not guaranteed savings for another model or codebase.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Reuse, Review, and Track Deliberate Shortcuts
en.capabilitiesIntro: Ponytail's guidance emphasizes inspection before new code, surrounding behavior, and visible deferred work. Compare those practices when reducing complexity, keeping the impact boundary and the checks already required by the repository part of the implementation decision.

capabilities.title: Inspect before adding code
capabilities.description: Trace the affected flow and look for an existing component, library function, or platform feature before introducing a dependency or abstraction.

capabilities.title: Review the surrounding behavior
capabilities.description: The review examines the change and code it touches; the audit expands that investigation across a repository and prioritizes findings.

capabilities.title: Keep deferred work visible
capabilities.description: Deliberate shortcut comments can be collected into a debt ledger, so a temporary compromise retains a reason and a point for reconsideration.

useCases.title: Use Cases for Ponytail
useCases.description: Date controls, field renames, and growing abstractions reveal different kinds of unnecessary complexity. Explore Ponytail's code-reuse approach while keeping caller impact, real invalid inputs, and the repository's existing quality checks part of the decision.

items.title: Add a form control
items.description: Before adding a custom date picker, inspect the form's validation rules, existing Input component, and target browsers' native support. Choose the smallest change that meets the actual requirement, then check keyboard use and submission behavior. Extra abstraction should solve a demonstrated limitation rather than precede that investigation.

items.title: Review a field rename
items.description: A field rename can affect serializers and consumers outside the visible diff. Trace callers, stored or transmitted formats, and response handlers before accepting the edit. The impact review should identify code that was not changed but still depends on the old name, so a small patch does not conceal a wider breakage.

items.title: Reduce a sprawling implementation
items.description: When an implementation grows beyond its requirement, compare each abstraction with the behavior it actually serves. Remove speculative branches while retaining validation and error handling for real invalid inputs. The leaner design should remain accountable to those examples rather than pursue fewer lines at the expense of required behavior.

items.title: Make deferred work explicit at handoff
items.description: Keeping an implementation small can leave useful ideas outside the accepted scope. Record what was intentionally deferred, why the current requirements do not need it, and which behavior has actually been checked. Ponytail's emphasis on visible deferred work can inform that handoff, preventing a reviewer from mistaking a deliberate boundary for an unnoticed omission or a promise of unfinished functionality.

faq.question: Is Ponytail an autonomous agent or a model?
faq.answer: It is a Skill and plugin project that changes how an existing coding agent approaches work. It does not supply model weights or replace the host’s execution runtime.

faq.question: What is the difference between review and audit?
faq.answer: Review focuses on a change and the surrounding code it affects. Audit investigates the wider repository and orders findings by importance. Neither is simply a request to delete lines.

faq.question: Does every supported host get the same features?
faq.answer: No. Instruction-file adapters can load the rules without plugin commands. Hooks and command syntax depend on the host; check INSTALL.md for that integration.

faq.question: Is the task-cost band available in every agent?
faq.answer: No. The current documentation limits the band to supported Claude Code terminal and desktop environments. Other hosts can use the rules without that interface.

faq.question: Does less code mean skipping safeguards?
faq.answer: No. The project explicitly retains validation, error handling, security, and accessibility. Judge a smaller implementation by whether it meets the same requirements.

faq.question: Are the published benchmark gains guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are results from the maintainer’s stated tasks, models, and methodology. Test your own workloads and account for correctness, review effort, and host differences.

prerequisites.title: Select the Ponytail host adapter
prerequisites.description: A rules-file adapter and a supported plugin do not expose the same behavior. Check Ponytail's installation instructions for the intended host before relying on commands or lifecycle functions, keeping instruction loading separate from executable plugin support.

items.title: Choose a compatible adapter
items.description: Read INSTALL.md for your host. A rules-file adapter loads instructions; a supported plugin can expose commands and lifecycle behavior.

howTo.title: Compare Ponytail rules on a real task
howTo.description: Ponytail rules need a compatible host adapter and a task whose outcome can be compared. Preserve the repository's existing quality requirements during the trial, then judge the complete result rather than counting fewer lines as evidence that the guidance improved the work.

items.title: Keep your project contract
items.description: Review the rules alongside repository instructions and define the task’s correctness, security, and accessibility requirements before comparing implementations.

items.title: Measure a complete result
items.description: Compare accepted behavior, changed code, useful tests, and review findings on the same task. Report unverified behavior rather than treating a shorter diff as success.

en.seoDescription: Apply Ponytail’s reuse-first coding approach to existing agents. Review host-specific plugins, portable rules, change checks, and repository audits before adapting the workflow.

zh.seoTitle: Ponytail：优先复用的编码规则、修改审查与 Agent 插件
zh.description: Ponytail 为现有编程 Agent 提供优先复用、修改审查与仓库审计规则。了解如何减少不必要的实现，同时保留测试、安全和无障碍要求，为自己的代码工作流明确改动范围与验收标准。
overview: Ponytail 是 DietrichGebert 维护的开源编程指令集。核心 Skill 与精简版 AGENTS.md 要求 Agent 先理解受影响的代码，再选择解决方案：依次检查仓库已有实现、标准库、平台原生能力和已安装依赖，确有需要时才增加新代码。
项目还提供修改审查、整库审计与延期事项台账。不同宿主可通过插件或规则文件加载这套方法，但命令、生命周期钩子和界面能力并不完全相同。Ponytail 负责约束工作方式，模型、工具和执行循环仍由宿主提供。
对在 Floatboat 中组织代码任务的用户，它提供了控制实现范围、检查修改连带影响的方法。可以先选一项仓库任务，按同一验收标准比较结果。项目公布的基准测试有特定任务与模型条件，不能直接当作其他代码库必然节省成本的承诺。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 先复用，再审查，留下有依据的取舍
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 实现变小之后，调用影响和已验证行为仍应说得清楚。Ponytail 强调先调查、检查周边并保留暂缓事项，让简化建立在仓库质量要求上，而不是只追求更少的代码。

capabilities.title: 写之前读懂现有实现
capabilities.description: 沿受影响的数据流查找已有组件、库函数与平台能力，避免为已经解决的问题再次引入依赖或抽象。

capabilities.title: 把审查扩展到关联代码
capabilities.description: 修改审查检查 diff 及其影响的代码，整库审计则扩大调查范围，并按问题的重要程度组织结果。

capabilities.title: 让延期事项可以追踪
capabilities.description: 有意保留的 shortcut 注释可汇总为技术债台账，让暂时的取舍保留原因和重新处理的条件。

useCases.title: Ponytail的使用场景
useCases.description: 日期控件是否需要自建、字段改名会影响谁，以及抽象是否服务真实需求，都要回到已有代码判断。Ponytail 的复用思路结合周边行为与质量检查，让简化仍能维护必要验证。

items.title: 为表单增加日期输入
items.description: 新增日期选择功能前，先检查表单验证规则、现有 Input 组件及目标浏览器的原生支持。选择能够满足真实需求的最小改动，再验证键盘操作和提交行为。只有确认现有能力存在缺口后，才考虑增加自定义控件或抽象层。

items.title: 检查一次字段重命名
items.description: 字段重命名可能影响差异之外的序列化逻辑和消费方。接受修改前，沿调用位置、存储或传输格式及响应处理逻辑检查影响。审阅报告应指出没有被修改却依赖旧名称的代码，避免一个看似很小的补丁引发更大范围的问题。

items.title: 收敛不断膨胀的实现
items.description: 实现不断膨胀时，将每个抽象层与它真正服务的需求进行比较。移除推测性分支，同时保留处理真实无效输入的验证与错误逻辑。简化后的方案仍要通过这些样例检查，不能为了减少代码而损失必要行为。

items.title: 交接时说明有意暂缓的工作
items.description: 保持实现精简，可能意味着部分有价值的想法没有进入已接受范围。记录哪些内容有意暂缓、当前需求为什么不需要它，以及哪些行为真正经过检查。借鉴 Ponytail 对暂缓事项可见性的重视，让审阅者区分明确边界、意外遗漏和并未承诺的未完成功能。

faq.question: Ponytail 是独立 Agent 或模型吗？
faq.answer: 它是改变现有编程 Agent 工作方式的 Skill 与插件项目，不提供模型权重，也不替代宿主的执行运行时。

faq.question: review 和 audit 有什么区别？
faq.answer: review 围绕一次修改及其关联代码展开，audit 检查更广的仓库范围并排列问题优先级。两者都不只是找可以删除的代码。

faq.question: 不同宿主能使用同样的功能吗？
faq.answer: 不能一概而论。规则文件适配可以加载指令，但不一定带有插件命令；钩子与命令语法也依赖宿主，应查看 INSTALL.md。

faq.question: 任务成本面板可以在所有 Agent 中显示吗？
faq.answer: 不能。当前文档将 band 面板限定于受支持的 Claude Code 终端和桌面环境，其他宿主可以使用规则，但不包含这一界面。

faq.question: 减少代码是否意味着省略安全措施？
faq.answer: 不意味着。项目明确保留验证、错误处理、安全和无障碍要求。更小的实现仍须达到相同的功能与质量标准。

faq.question: 基准测试中的收益可以直接套用吗？
faq.answer: 不可以。那些结果来自维护者公布的任务、模型与测试方法。自己的工作负载仍需核对正确性、审阅成本和宿主差异。

prerequisites.title: 选择 Ponytail 宿主适配方式
prerequisites.description: 规则文件适配器与受支持插件提供的行为不同。以下条件依据 Ponytail 安装说明核对目标宿主，区分指令加载和可执行插件支持，再判断能否使用命令及生命周期功能。

items.title: 选择对应适配方式
items.description: 通过 INSTALL.md 查看宿主入口。规则文件用于加载指令，受支持的插件才可能提供命令与生命周期行为。

howTo.title: 用真实任务比较 Ponytail 规则
howTo.description: 减少代码只有在质量要求仍然满足时才有意义。选择兼容宿主适配后，保留仓库已有检查，并比较完整任务结果，判断 Ponytail 指引是否改善实现，而非只统计行数变化。

items.title: 保留项目自身的要求
items.description: 将规则与仓库说明一起检查，先写明正确性、安全和无障碍要求，再比较不同实现。

items.title: 比较完整交付结果
items.description: 用同一任务检查实际行为、代码变更、有效测试与审查发现。未核实的部分应明确指出，不能只凭 diff 更短判断完成。

zh.seoDescription: 了解 Ponytail 面向现有编程 Agent 的优先复用规则、修改审查与仓库审计，区分宿主插件和可移植指引，再根据实际加载方式调整自己的开发任务与检查流程。

en.seoTitle: MausBot: Role-Based Local Agents, Channels, and Approval
en.description: MausBot, published as OpenMausBot, organizes local agent engines as a team of chat contacts. Explore its role-based channels, execution events, and approval flow to design clearer handoffs and reusable team workflows.
overview: MausBot is an open-source desktop application maintained in milind-soni/OpenMausBot. Its README also uses OpenMausBot and records the former OpenGrokBot name. It presents agents as chat contacts, with separate roles, model choices, conversations, and optional computer and application connections.

The interface talks to a local harness server that manages agent processes and converts provider events into a common stream. The documented engines include Claude, Codex, and Grok CLIs. Local transcripts and workspace data do not make every operation offline: model requests, connected services, and cloud computers have their own data paths and access terms.

For a Floatboat workflow, the useful design questions are how to divide responsibility, preserve shared context, and ask for approval at the right point. MausBot’s channels and portable team packages provide concrete examples. Studying that design does not establish an installed integration between the two applications.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Coordinate Roles, Context, and Decisions
en.capabilitiesIntro: MausBot connects channel-specific context, engine activity, and portable team instructions through different responsibilities. Compare its conversation and execution layers while retaining the permission checks needed for local computer use, connected services, and tasks that leave the chat.

capabilities.title: Give a channel its own context
capabilities.description: Channels can define a working folder, shared instructions, bot roster, and responder rules, so several roles can work within one explicit context.

capabilities.title: Normalize engine activity
capabilities.description: A local server owns the agent processes and exposes a common event stream. Tool activity and permission requests can be presented without making every engine’s protocol the user interface.

capabilities.title: Package a repeatable team
capabilities.description: Team files can describe bots, channels, playbooks, and suggested routines. Import review and paused routines separate reusable instructions from live permissions.

useCases.title: Use Cases for MausBot
useCases.description: Research review, recurring operations, and team playbook transfer need shared material without shared credentials. Examine MausBot's role-based approach while distinguishing the draft handoff, service reconnection, and authorization required for actions outside the conversation.

items.title: Separate research from review
items.description: Research and verification can be assigned to separate roles when both work from traceable source material. Define the shared folder, citation expectations, and evidence required at handoff, then have the review role check claims against those sources. The package should make disagreements and unsupported claims easy to locate.

items.title: Prepare a recurring operations brief
items.description: A recurring operations brief needs a schedule, approved information sources, and a report format. Design the routine around preparing a draft and handing it to review. Sending messages or changing external records remains a separate action, with the required connection and authorization checked before it occurs.

items.title: Reuse an established team playbook
items.description: A team playbook can package reviewed roles and instructions for another environment. Include what the receiving team needs to understand the method, then reconnect services and approve execution there. Keep existing credentials out of the package so reusable task knowledge does not carry one environment's access into another.

items.title: Inspect a portable team package
items.description: Before reusing a team playbook in another environment, examine the roles, instructions, references, and any included task material. Identify which services need fresh connections and which actions still require consent from the receiving user. Keep credentials and machine access out of the assumed handoff so the reusable package transfers a reviewed method rather than one environment's authority.

faq.question: Are MausBot and OpenMausBot different projects?
faq.answer: The upstream README identifies MausBot as another name for OpenMausBot and records OpenGrokBot as a former name. The canonical source used here is milind-soni/OpenMausBot.

faq.question: Is MausBot a language model?
faq.answer: No. It is an application and local harness around supported agent engines. Bot roles and model choices sit above those engines; inference still depends on the selected provider.

faq.question: Does local-first mean all work stays offline?
faq.answer: No. Local conversations and workspace data coexist with requests to model providers, connected applications, or cloud computers when those features are used. Evaluate each enabled service separately.

faq.question: What makes a channel different from a single bot thread?
faq.answer: A channel can hold shared instructions, a working folder, multiple bots, and responder rules. It defines the context in which those roles collaborate.

faq.question: Can a shared team package carry live credentials?
faq.answer: The documented team-sharing flow excludes keys, passwords, chat history, model choices, and computers. Import behavior differs for organization-managed packages, so inspect the relevant sharing documentation.

faq.question: Is the open-source app the same as free model and cloud access?
faq.answer: No. Apache-2.0 covers the application source. Agent accounts, API usage, connected services, cloud computers, and managed offerings have separate costs and terms.

prerequisites.title: Prepare MausBot engines and connections
prerequisites.description: A working agent engine, computer or service access, and a reviewed team package are separate prerequisites. Check the route needed by the task and the receiving environment's permissions; a shared playbook does not supply credentials or unlimited model access.

items.title: Confirm a working agent engine
items.description: The desktop setup checks a supported local engine and its account. An open-source application does not include unlimited model access or remove provider limits.

items.title: Choose the computer and connections
items.description: Local computer use, cloud desktops, and connected applications require different permissions and services. Test the specific path needed by the task.

items.title: Check approvals and portable data
items.description: Review what the team file contains and which actions require consent. A shared playbook should not be treated as a transfer of credentials or computer access.

en.seoDescription: Study MausBot’s desktop coordination of local agent engines, role-based bots, and shared channels. Examine execution events and approval before planning collaborative tasks.

zh.seoTitle: MausBot：角色化本地 Agent、共享频道与人工审批
zh.description: MausBot 以 OpenMausBot 发布，将本地 Agent 引擎组织为聊天式团队。了解角色频道、执行事件与人工审批，借鉴共享上下文和团队包的设计，为自己的工作流明确分工、交接与执行环境。
overview: MausBot 是在 milind-soni/OpenMausBot 仓库维护的开源桌面应用。README 同时使用 OpenMausBot 名称，并记录其曾用名 OpenGrokBot。它把 Agent 呈现为聊天联系人，各自拥有角色、模型选择、对话，以及可选的电脑和应用连接。
界面通过本地 harness 服务管理 Agent 进程，将不同供应方的事件转换为统一事件流。文档列出的引擎包括 Claude、Codex 和 Grok CLI。本地保存对话与工作区资料，并不代表所有任务都离线完成；模型请求、外部应用和云电脑仍有各自的数据流向与访问条件。
对 Floatboat 用户，更值得借鉴的是如何划分角色、保留共享上下文，以及在正确的步骤请求审批。MausBot 的频道与可移植团队包提供了具体实现参考；研究这些机制，不代表两个应用之间已经完成安装或集成。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 把角色、上下文与审批组织在一起
zh.capabilitiesIntro: MausBot 将频道背景、引擎活动和可移植团队指令连接起来。对话层呈现工作，执行层使用具体服务或电脑权限；分享一套角色说明，并不会同时完成这些连接和授权。

capabilities.title: 为频道定义共同背景
capabilities.description: 频道可以包含工作目录、共享指令、参与的 bot 和响应规则，让多个角色围绕同一任务背景协作。

capabilities.title: 统一不同引擎的执行事件
capabilities.description: 本地服务管理 Agent 进程并输出统一事件流，使工具活动与权限请求能够在同一界面中呈现。

capabilities.title: 把团队方法打包复用
capabilities.description: 团队文件可描述 bot、频道、操作手册和建议例行任务，导入审阅与暂停状态将可复用说明和实际授权分开。

useCases.title: MausBot的使用场景
useCases.description: 研究与核验可以分工，运营简报可以周期准备，团队方法也可以迁移复用。借鉴 MausBot 时，需要让资料交接、服务重连和外部执行权限分别明确，不能把共享手册当作凭据转移。

items.title: 将资料收集与事实复核分开
items.description: 研究和核验可以由不同角色承担，但需要共享可追溯的来源。先约定资料目录、引用要求和交接时必须提供的证据，再由审阅角色逐条对照原文检查主张。交付包应方便定位存在分歧或缺少支持的内容。

items.title: 准备周期性的运营简报
items.description: 周期性运营简报需要明确时间表、允许的信息来源和报告格式。围绕草稿准备及审阅交接设计流程，把发送消息或修改外部记录单独处理。这些外部行动实际发生前，仍需核对相应连接和授权，不能由定时准备环节直接代替。

items.title: 复用已经跑通的团队方法
items.description: 团队工作手册可以将已审阅的角色与指令打包给另一个环境使用。交付理解方法所需的资料后，在接收端重新连接服务并确认执行权限。包中不携带原环境凭据，使可复用的是任务知识，而不是跨环境转移的访问权限。

items.title: 检查可移植团队包的内容
items.description: 在另一个环境复用团队手册前，检查角色、指令、引用和随附任务资料。明确哪些服务需要重新连接，哪些行动仍需接收方同意。交接不能默认携带凭据或机器访问，让可复用包转移的是已审阅方法，而不是原环境的权限。

faq.question: MausBot 和 OpenMausBot 是两个项目吗？
faq.answer: 上游 README 将 MausBot 列为 OpenMausBot 的另一名称，并记录 OpenGrokBot 为曾用名。这里采用的原始仓库是 milind-soni/OpenMausBot。

faq.question: MausBot 本身是大语言模型吗？
faq.answer: 不是。它是围绕受支持 Agent 引擎构建的应用与本地 harness。角色与模型选择位于引擎之上，推理仍取决于选用的供应方。

faq.question: 本地优先代表所有任务都不联网吗？
faq.answer: 不代表。本地保存的对话和工作区资料，可以与发往模型供应方、外部应用或云电脑的请求同时存在。需要分别检查实际启用的服务。

faq.question: 频道和单个 bot 对话有什么不同？
faq.answer: 频道可以定义共享指令、工作目录、多个 bot 以及响应规则，为这些角色提供共同的协作背景。

faq.question: 共享团队包会携带真实凭证吗？
faq.answer: 文档中的团队共享流程排除密钥、密码、聊天历史、模型选择和电脑配置。组织管理的导入流程可能不同，应核对对应的共享说明。

faq.question: 开源应用是否包含免费模型和云电脑？
faq.answer: 不包含。Apache-2.0 覆盖应用源码；Agent 账号、API 用量、外部服务、云电脑和托管方案有各自的费用与条款。

prerequisites.title: 准备 MausBot 引擎与连接
prerequisites.description: 可用 Agent 引擎、电脑或服务访问，以及已审阅团队包，是不同前提。以下条件按任务路径和接收环境核对权限；共享手册不提供凭据，也不代表拥有无限模型访问。

items.title: 确认可用的 Agent 引擎
items.description: 桌面引导会检查受支持的本地引擎和账号。应用开源不包含无限模型额度，也不会取消供应方的使用限制。

items.title: 选择电脑与应用连接
items.description: 本机操作、云桌面与外部应用需要不同权限和服务，应针对任务真正使用的路径验证。

items.title: 核对审批与团队包内容
items.description: 检查共享文件包含什么，以及哪些动作需要确认。操作手册不能被当作凭证或电脑访问权的转移。

zh.seoDescription: 研究 MausBot 桌面应用如何协调本地 Agent 引擎、角色与共享频道，查看执行事件和人工审批的作用，为协作任务安排职责与交接，而不是把聊天界面当作完整执行环境。

en.seoTitle: Agent Desktop: Accessibility Trees, App Actions, and Verification
en.description: Agent Desktop exposes desktop apps through operating-system accessibility trees. Explore Vercel Labs’ CLI and C library to design observe–act–verify workflows, handle stale element references, and check platform permissions before automating a task.
overview: Agent Desktop is an open-source desktop automation tool from Vercel Labs. Its CLI and C library expose app structure through operating-system accessibility APIs, returning JSON snapshots and references to actionable elements. The calling agent chooses the next step; Agent Desktop supplies observation and control rather than its own planning model.

The core interaction is to inspect a snapshot, act on an element reference, and inspect the result. References belong to their snapshot, so an outdated or ambiguous target calls for renewed observation. Accessibility actions are headless by default; enabling physical input is a separate choice, and exact capabilities differ across operating systems.

For workflows organized in Floatboat, the project provides a reference for desktop steps that need observable targets and explicit verification. Examples include entering prepared data into an application and checking the resulting state. Reusing the tool requires a compatible integration and the necessary permissions; a directory listing does not connect it to Floatboat.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Observe, Act, and Verify Desktop State
en.capabilitiesIntro: Agent Desktop exposes application structure, scoped targets, and action results as different evidence. Review how JSON snapshots and element references support control, then distinguish a successful command from confirmation that the intended state was actually saved in the application.

capabilities.title: Read app structure as JSON
capabilities.description: Snapshots expose roles, labels, windows, and actionable references through native accessibility APIs. This gives the caller a structured view of supported application controls.

capabilities.title: Act on scoped element references
capabilities.description: Clicks and value changes target references from an observed snapshot. Stale or ambiguous references require another snapshot instead of silently retargeting an action.

capabilities.title: Inspect errors before retrying
capabilities.description: Command envelopes describe success or a structured error. The documented retry disposition helps the caller distinguish a safe retry from an action that needs investigation.

useCases.title: Use Cases for Agent Desktop
useCases.description: Application entry, changing lists, and runtime adapters need current desktop evidence. Explore Agent Desktop's control model through target localization and saved-value checks, while keeping approval and final verification in the workflow that surrounds each call.

items.title: Transfer reviewed information into an app
items.description: Transferring information into an application starts with validated source data and a defined set of permitted fields. Locate the actual controls before entering values, then read back what was saved. Stop when the values or target do not match the intended record instead of continuing through an uncertain desktop state.

items.title: Recover after a list changes
items.description: A changed list can invalidate an earlier row position or control reference. If an item disappears or the target becomes ambiguous, take a fresh snapshot and locate it again using the intended row's identifying criteria. Retain the new action evidence instead of relying on stale coordinates.

items.title: Embed control in an existing runtime
items.description: An agent runtime that already owns planning and task context can compare CLI calls with the C library as desktop-control interfaces. Map the needed calls to existing permissions and runtime boundaries. Keep approval decisions and verification of the resulting desktop state in the surrounding workflow, regardless of the adapter chosen.

items.title: Diagnose an unsuccessful desktop action
items.description: A failed control call may reflect an inaccessible target, changed application state, or an unmet platform condition. Inspect the returned error and current observation before retrying, then compare the result with the target application's actual state. Keep any permission change or approval decision in the surrounding workflow instead of treating repeated calls as a substitute for understanding the failure.

faq.question: Is Agent Desktop an agent harness or a model?
faq.answer: It is a tool an agent can invoke, delivered as a CLI and C library. The surrounding agent still owns planning, model calls, approvals, and the decision to continue.

faq.question: How does it differ from Agent Browser?
faq.answer: Agent Desktop targets desktop applications through OS accessibility APIs. Agent Browser focuses on browser automation. Choose the tool according to where the task’s controls actually live.

faq.question: What happens when an element reference becomes stale?
faq.answer: References are scoped to snapshots. On a stale or ambiguous target, observe again and use a reference from the new snapshot rather than assuming the old reference still identifies the intended element.

faq.question: Does headless mean it runs without a graphical environment?
faq.answer: No. Here it means default actions use accessibility APIs without taking focus or moving the pointer. Linux still needs the user’s graphical session, and physical-input capabilities have additional platform conditions.

faq.question: Can all three operating systems perform the same actions?
faq.answer: No. The documentation lists platform-specific differences for mouse input, screenshots, clipboard access, notifications, and system surfaces. Check the current table for the actual environment.

faq.question: Does a Skill installation include desktop permissions?
faq.answer: No. Instructions explain how an agent should use the tool. The executable, its platform helpers, OS permissions, and any host integration remain separate setup requirements.

prerequisites.title: Check Agent Desktop platform access
prerequisites.description: Desktop control depends on platform permissions, the target application's accessibility exposure, and the observation data collected. Check those conditions for the actual operating system and display environment before using screenshots, clipboard contents, or model-backed helpers in a task.

items.title: Confirm permissions and session access
items.description: macOS requires Accessibility permission. Windows control is constrained by process integrity level; Linux needs an accessible graphical session and the documented platform dependencies.

items.title: Check the exact app and display system
items.description: Validate the target app’s accessibility exposure. Linux X11 and Wayland differ for input, screenshots, and clipboard operations; read the current platform capability table.

items.title: Limit sensitive observation data
items.description: Snapshots, clipboard contents, screenshots, and traces can contain private material. Keep the collected evidence scoped to the task and check any optional model-backed helper separately.

en.seoDescription: Study Vercel Labs Agent Desktop’s accessibility-tree approach to reading and operating apps. Examine scoped element references and observe–act–verify loops for desktop tasks.

zh.seoTitle: Agent Desktop：无障碍树、应用操作与结果验证
zh.description: Agent Desktop 通过操作系统无障碍树读取并操作桌面应用。了解 Vercel Labs 的 CLI 与 C 库，围绕观察、操作和验证设计桌面工作流，处理失效元素引用，并核对不同平台的权限与能力边界。
zh.overviewTitle: 关于 Vercel Labs Agent Desktop
overview: Agent Desktop 是 Vercel Labs 发布的开源桌面自动化工具，通过 CLI 与 C 库访问操作系统无障碍接口，将应用结构转换为 JSON 快照和可操作元素引用。下一步由调用它的 Agent 决定；工具负责观察与控制，不自带负责规划的模型。
它的核心循环是读取快照、操作元素引用，再次观察结果。引用属于对应快照，目标失效或存在歧义时需要重新观察。默认操作通过无障碍接口执行，不主动抢占焦点；允许物理输入是另一项选择，具体能力也因操作系统而异。
对在 Floatboat 中组织的工作流，它为需要明确目标与结果验证的桌面步骤提供参考，例如把已核对的数据录入应用，再检查保存后的状态。实际复用仍需兼容的集成方式与必要权限，目录收录不会自动将这一工具接入 Floatboat。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 观察桌面状态，操作后再次验证
zh.capabilitiesIntro: JSON 快照描述应用结构，元素引用限定动作目标，返回值则记录命令结果。Agent Desktop 的这些证据需要配合实际状态检查，执行成功本身不能证明预期内容已经保存到应用中。

capabilities.title: 把应用结构转为 JSON
capabilities.description: 快照通过原生无障碍接口返回角色、标签、窗口与可操作引用，为调用方提供受支持控件的结构化视图。

capabilities.title: 按快照中的元素引用操作
capabilities.description: 点击和赋值指向已观察的元素引用；目标过期或无法唯一确定时，需要重新取快照，而不是悄悄换一个目标继续。

capabilities.title: 先理解错误再决定重试
capabilities.description: 命令返回统一结果与结构化错误；重试标记帮助调用方判断可以安全重复，还是必须先调查当前状态。

useCases.title: Agent Desktop的使用场景
useCases.description: 向应用录入资料后要读回保存值，列表变化后要重新定位目标。Agent Desktop 的控制方式可用于研究这些桌面流程，运行层的批准和最终核验仍由外围工作流承担。

items.title: 把已核对资料录入应用
items.description: 向应用录入信息前，先核验源数据并明确允许填写的字段。定位真实控件后再输入，保存后重新读取结果进行核对。如果目标或保存值与预期记录不一致，应停止处理，避免在不确定的桌面状态下继续操作。

items.title: 在列表变化后恢复操作
items.description: 列表变化可能让之前的行位置或控件引用失效。条目消失或目标不明确时，重新获取快照，依据目标记录的识别条件再次定位。后续行动保留重新定位后的证据，不依赖已经过期的坐标或引用继续操作。

items.title: 为既有运行层补充桌面能力
items.description: 已有规划和任务上下文的 Agent 运行时，可以将 CLI 调用与 C 库作为桌面控制接口进行比较。把所需操作对应到现有权限和运行边界，并将批准判断与桌面结果验证保留在外围工作流中，不因选用某种适配器而省略。

items.title: 调查未成功的桌面动作
items.description: 控制调用失败，可能与目标不可访问、应用状态变化或平台条件未满足有关。重试前检查返回错误和当前观察，再对照目标应用的实际状态判断原因。权限调整和批准仍交给外围工作流处理，不用反复调用代替对失败机制的理解。

faq.question: Agent Desktop 是 Agent Harness 或模型吗？
faq.answer: 它是可由 Agent 调用的工具，以 CLI 和 C 库交付。规划、模型请求、审批以及是否继续执行，仍由外围 Agent 与工作流负责。

faq.question: 它和 Agent Browser 有什么区别？
faq.answer: Agent Desktop 通过操作系统无障碍接口操作桌面应用；Agent Browser 主要面向浏览器自动化。应根据任务控件实际所在的环境选择。

faq.question: 元素引用失效时应该怎么办？
faq.answer: 引用受对应快照约束。目标过期或存在歧义时，应重新观察并使用新快照中的引用，不能假定旧引用仍指向原来的元素。

faq.question: 默认 headless 是否代表不需要图形环境？
faq.answer: 不是。这里指默认通过无障碍接口操作，不抢占焦点或移动鼠标。Linux 仍需要用户图形会话，物理输入还受额外平台条件限制。

faq.question: 三个操作系统的能力完全相同吗？
faq.answer: 不相同。文档分别说明鼠标输入、截图、剪贴板、通知与系统面板等差异，需要针对实际运行环境核对当前能力表。

faq.question: 安装 Skill 就拥有桌面操作权限了吗？
faq.answer: 没有。Skill 说明 Agent 应如何使用工具；可执行程序、平台辅助文件、操作系统权限与宿主集成仍是独立的准备条件。

prerequisites.title: 核对 Agent Desktop 平台访问条件
prerequisites.description: 桌面控制依赖平台权限、目标应用的无障碍暴露和所采集观察数据。以下条件需要结合操作系统与显示环境核对，再在任务中使用截图、剪贴板内容或模型辅助功能。

items.title: 确认权限与会话条件
items.description: macOS 需要无障碍权限；Windows 操作受进程完整性级别限制；Linux 需要可访问的图形会话及文档要求的平台依赖。

items.title: 核对应用与显示系统
items.description: 先验证目标应用是否暴露需要的无障碍控件。Linux 的 X11 与 Wayland 在输入、截图和剪贴板方面存在差异，应查看当前平台能力表。

items.title: 控制观察资料的范围
items.description: 快照、剪贴板、截图与跟踪记录可能包含私人资料，应只采集任务所需证据，并单独检查可选模型辅助功能的数据流向。

zh.seoDescription: 研究 Vercel Labs Agent Desktop 通过无障碍树读取和操作应用的方法，了解元素引用范围及观察、操作、验证循环，为桌面任务安排可检查步骤，并核对平台与运行要求。

en.seoTitle: ComfyUI Workflows: Nodes, Model Dependencies, and Media Creation
en.description: ComfyUI turns generative-media steps into reusable node graphs. Explore workflow JSON, model and custom-node dependencies, queued execution, and API handoffs to design a visual-production process with inspectable inputs and outputs.
overview: ComfyUI is a node-based interface and execution engine for generative-media workflows. A graph connects operations such as loading a model, conditioning generation, processing media, and saving an output. The open core is maintained in Comfy-Org/ComfyUI; desktop packaging and the frontend have related repositories rather than being separate Skills.

Workflows can be saved as JSON, reused, extended with custom nodes, and invoked through API entry points. That makes the graph a concrete description of a production process, but reproducing a result also requires the relevant model files, node versions, settings, and runtime environment.

For work organized in Floatboat, study how a prepared brief becomes a bounded media-generation step and how its outputs return for review. Local execution, paid cloud services, and partner-model API nodes have different requirements. The core license does not grant rights to every model, extension, or generated asset.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Build a Generation Process You Can Inspect
en.capabilitiesIntro: ComfyUI graphs connect explicit media operations with reusable workflow state and bounded jobs. Compare how inputs, model dependencies, and intermediate outputs remain attached to each stage, making it easier to trace a weak result and hand off a reproducible recipe.

capabilities.title: Connect explicit processing steps
capabilities.description: Use the graph to identify which operation loads a model, consumes a prompt or reference, transforms an intermediate result, and saves the deliverable.

capabilities.title: Preserve a reusable workflow
capabilities.description: Keep workflow JSON alongside the model identifiers, custom-node requirements, and relevant settings needed to reproduce the task.

capabilities.title: Hand off a bounded job
capabilities.description: Use the documented queue and API surfaces when another application prepares inputs or collects results. Define the actual integration separately.

useCases.title: Use Cases for ComfyUI
useCases.description: Image series, finishing stages, and portable production recipes need both media and environment checks. Explore how ComfyUI graphs preserve operation order, model dependencies, and representative inputs so results can be reviewed and reproduced by another collaborator.

items.title: Prepare a consistent image series
items.description: A consistent image series starts with product originals, style constraints, output sizes, and available models. Keep the workflow and model setup stable while varying the brief or source asset, then compare every result against the same subject and background criteria. Retain the inputs so the series remains traceable.

items.title: Separate generation from finishing
items.description: A media graph can separate generation from masking, resizing, upscaling, and compositing. Represent the required finishing stages explicitly and keep each result connected to the operation that produced it. When a frame looks wrong, the graph should help locate the responsible stage instead of forcing the entire workflow to be rebuilt.

items.title: Reuse a reviewed production recipe
items.description: A reviewed workflow JSON is only part of a reusable production recipe. Package the custom nodes, model dependencies, representative inputs, and acceptance images before handing it to another machine or collaborator. Those materials make the expected output and the environment needed to reproduce it visible together.

items.title: Review dependencies before adopting a graph
items.description: A shared workflow may rely on custom nodes, model weights, or external services that are not present in the receiving environment. Inspect those requirements and their stated terms before running the graph, then test a representative input under the intended setup. Keep dependency and output checks together so a portable workflow file is not mistaken for a self-contained production environment.

faq.question: Is ComfyUI a Skill?
faq.answer: No. It is a visual application and execution engine. A separate Skill may explain how to operate it, but the node graph and runtime are software components.

faq.question: Is a workflow JSON enough to reproduce an output?
faq.answer: Not by itself. Model files, custom nodes, versions, seeds, settings, and hardware-dependent behavior can affect execution and results.

faq.question: Are custom nodes included in every installation?
faq.answer: No. A shared workflow may depend on extensions that must be installed and reviewed separately. Check the graph's required node types before running it.

faq.question: Can an agent invoke ComfyUI through an API?
faq.answer: ComfyUI documents API-based workflow execution. A calling agent still needs an implemented connection, access to the deployment, validated inputs, and a way to review outputs.

faq.question: Does local ComfyUI require a paid cloud plan?
faq.answer: The open core can run locally with suitable dependencies and hardware. Official cloud services and partner-model API nodes are separate offerings.

faq.question: Does the core license cover all models and media?
faq.answer: No. The core uses GPL-3.0; model weights, custom nodes, provider APIs, and input assets can have separate conditions.

prerequisites.title: Check ComfyUI models and dependencies
prerequisites.description: Hardware and operating-system support are only part of a ComfyUI setup. Review custom-node dependencies, model terms, and any external API conditions alongside the workflow, since each can affect whether another environment can reproduce the intended output.

items.title: Choose a supported runtime
items.description: Follow the official installation path for your operating system and hardware. Memory and performance depend on the selected models and workflow.

items.title: Review extensions and model terms
items.description: Custom nodes add executable dependencies, while model weights and external APIs have their own licenses or service conditions.

howTo.title: Validate a ComfyUI workflow before batching
howTo.description: A reusable media workflow should first succeed with representative inputs and known dependencies. Resolve the environment, inspect saved outputs, and retain the setup needed to reproduce them before increasing the batch size or handing the recipe to another machine.

items.title: Test a complete sample
items.description: Load the workflow, resolve its dependencies, run a representative input, and inspect the saved result before automating a batch.

en.seoDescription: Build reusable image and video workflows with ComfyUI nodes. Understand model and custom-node dependencies, preserve workflow settings, and inspect outputs before reuse.

zh.seoTitle: ComfyUI 工作流：节点编排、模型依赖与生成媒体制作
zh.description: ComfyUI 将生成媒体的步骤组织为可复用节点图。了解工作流 JSON、模型与自定义节点依赖、任务队列和 API 交接，为视觉生产流程明确输入、处理步骤与结果验收。
overview: ComfyUI 是面向生成媒体的节点式界面与执行引擎。节点图连接模型加载、生成条件、媒体处理和输出保存等操作。开源核心维护于 Comfy-Org/ComfyUI，桌面打包与前端由相关仓库协作完成，不应分别包装成 Skills。
工作流可以保存为 JSON，加入自定义节点，或通过 API 入口执行。节点图为生产过程提供了明确描述，但复现结果还需要对应的模型文件、节点版本、参数和运行环境。
在 Floatboat 中组织工作时，可以借鉴它如何把创作需求转换为有边界的生成步骤，再将输出交回审阅。本地运行、付费云服务和合作模型 API 节点有不同条件；核心许可不覆盖所有模型、扩展或生成素材的权利。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 让生成过程可以检查与复用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: ComfyUI 图把输入、模型依赖和中间输出对应到具体操作。结果不理想时，可以沿阶段追查原因；交接制作方案时，还需保留这些对应关系，不能只传递最终图文件。

capabilities.title: 连接明确的处理步骤
capabilities.description: 通过节点图识别模型加载、提示词或参考资料输入、中间结果处理和最终保存各自承担的职责。

capabilities.title: 保存可复用的工作流
capabilities.description: 将工作流 JSON 与模型标识、自定义节点要求及关键参数放在一起，保留再次执行所需的信息。

capabilities.title: 交接一项有边界的任务
capabilities.description: 其他应用准备输入或收集输出时，可研究队列与 API；实际接入方式仍需单独实现和验证。

useCases.title: ComfyUI的使用场景
useCases.description: 同一组图片需要一致制作条件，后期阶段需要可追查，跨电脑复用还需要依赖齐全。ComfyUI 图可以组织这些媒体流程，并结合代表输入及输出检查判断是否真正能够复现。

items.title: 准备风格一致的图片系列
items.description: 制作一致的图片系列时，先准备产品原图、风格约束、输出尺寸和可用模型。保持工作流与模型设置稳定，只调整简报或源素材，再按同一套主体和背景标准比较结果。保留输入信息，让整组图片能够追溯到具体制作条件。

items.title: 区分生成与后期处理
items.description: 媒体工作流可以将生成与遮罩、缩放、放大及合成等处理分开。把真正需要的后期阶段明确放进图中，让结果对应到产生它的具体操作。画面出现问题时，可以沿图定位环节，而不是每次都重新搭建完整流程。

items.title: 复用已验证的制作方法
items.description: 经过验证的工作流 JSON 只是复用生产方案的一部分。交接给其他电脑或协作者前，还需整理自定义节点、模型依赖、代表性输入和参考验收图。将预期效果与复现它所需的环境一起说明，便于接收者核对条件和结果。

items.title: 采用工作流前核对依赖
items.description: 共享流程可能依赖接收环境中没有的自定义节点、模型权重或外部服务。运行前检查这些要求和各自条款，再在目标配置下测试代表输入。将依赖与输出检查放在一起，避免把可移植工作流文件误当成已经自带全部条件的制作环境。

faq.question: ComfyUI 是 Skill 吗？
faq.answer: 不是。它是视觉应用与执行引擎。单独的 Skill 可以说明如何使用它，但节点图与运行时属于软件组件。

faq.question: 只有工作流 JSON 就能复现结果吗？
faq.answer: 不能保证。模型文件、自定义节点、版本、种子、参数和硬件相关行为都会影响执行或结果。

faq.question: 所有安装都包含需要的自定义节点吗？
faq.answer: 不一定。共享工作流可能依赖额外扩展，应先核对节点类型及其安装与来源要求。

faq.question: Agent 可以通过 API 调用 ComfyUI 吗？
faq.answer: 官方提供工作流执行 API。调用方仍需实现连接，具备对应部署的访问权，并验证输入与输出。

faq.question: 本地使用是否必须购买云服务？
faq.answer: 开源核心可以在具备相应依赖和硬件的本地环境运行，官方云服务与合作模型 API 节点属于独立方案。

faq.question: 核心许可是否覆盖所有模型和素材？
faq.answer: 不覆盖。核心采用 GPL-3.0，模型权重、自定义节点、供应方 API 与输入素材可能有各自条件。

prerequisites.title: 核对 ComfyUI 模型与依赖
prerequisites.description: 硬件与系统支持只是 ComfyUI 配置的一部分。以下条件同时核对自定义节点依赖、模型条款及外部 API 要求，因为它们都会影响另一个环境能否复现预期结果。

items.title: 选择适合的运行方式
items.description: 按操作系统与硬件采用官方安装方案，所需内存和实际速度取决于模型与具体工作流。

items.title: 核对扩展和模型条款
items.description: 自定义节点会增加可执行依赖，模型权重与外部 API 也有独立的许可或服务条件。

howTo.title: 批量运行前验证 ComfyUI 工作流
howTo.description: 可移植流程需要的不只是图文件，还包括依赖、代表输入和可检查输出。先在当前环境跑通并保存复现条件，再扩大批次或迁移到其他电脑，减少交接后的环境遗漏。

items.title: 验证一个完整样本
items.description: 加载工作流、补齐依赖、执行代表性输入并检查保存结果，再扩展到批量任务。

zh.seoDescription: 将图像与视频生成组织为可复用节点流程，了解 ComfyUI 的模型、自定义节点和运行依赖，记录配置并检查实际输出，为后续制作和协作保留可追溯的项目资料。

en.seoTitle: Graphify: Code Knowledge Graphs, Provenance, and Agent Context
en.description: Graphify maps code and supporting material into a queryable knowledge graph. Explore the local CLI and its agent Skill together, distinguish extracted links from inferred relationships, and use source-backed context for repository investigations.
overview: Graphify combines a Python command-line tool with agent integration instructions to build and query knowledge graphs. The open project is maintained by Graphify Labs. Its CLI and /graphify Skill describe one workflow, so this page covers them together rather than creating competing introductions.

Code parsing uses local AST analysis, while semantic processing of documents or media can use an assistant model or configured backend. Graph relationships distinguish extracted source connections from inferred ones. The generated graph, interactive view, and report are useful navigation artifacts, but an inferred edge is not independent proof that a behavior occurs.

For a Floatboat repository task, use the graph as a map to relevant source files and relationships before reviewing the actual code. Keep the graph current with the source revision. The Apache-2.0 local tool and hosted Graphify services have distinct setup, data-processing, and commercial conditions.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Turn Repository Structure into Navigable Context
en.capabilitiesIntro: Graphify distinguishes parsed code relationships, focused queries, and relationship provenance. Compare those layers when narrowing an investigation, then return to the cited files so semantic links and extracted structure do not silently become claims of verified program behavior.

capabilities.title: Parse explicit code relationships
capabilities.description: Local syntax analysis extracts connections such as imports and calls, giving an agent a structured starting point for a codebase question.

capabilities.title: Query a focused part of the graph
capabilities.description: Query, path, and explain operations can select a relevant subgraph rather than supplying an entire repository as undifferentiated context.

capabilities.title: Retain relationship provenance
capabilities.description: Extracted and inferred labels help distinguish direct source evidence from relationships that still need validation.

useCases.title: Use Cases for Graphify
useCases.description: Feature investigation, refactor planning, and design-note comparison require different paths through a codebase. Use Graphify to narrow those paths, then confirm relationships in the cited files while preserving the distinction between inferred connections and verified behavior.

items.title: Locate the path behind a feature
items.description: Feature investigation can begin with an entry point, key concepts, and a bounded source scope. Follow the graph's connected modules and concepts, then open the relevant files to confirm the path before proposing edits. Distinguish inferred relationships from source-confirmed calls and implementation locations.

items.title: Check a refactor boundary
items.description: A structural refactor needs its callers, dependencies, public interfaces, and related tests considered together. Inspect connected documentation as well as code before drawing the boundary of the change. The impact report should identify which contracts and tests must remain intact when modules are reorganized.

items.title: Connect code to its design notes
items.description: Connecting design notes to code requires both sources in the same investigation. Map design claims to implementation locations, checking the files that establish actual behavior. Keep semantic graph inferences separate and mark evidence gaps so a plausible relationship is not reported as a verified implementation fact.

items.title: Check the provenance of a graph relation
items.description: A useful connection in the graph may come from explicit code structure or a semantic inference. Inspect the relation's recorded origin and the cited material before using it to support an implementation claim. Keep inferred links as investigation leads when direct evidence is missing, and document what would need to be checked rather than presenting the graph itself as proof of behavior.

faq.question: Is Graphify software or a Skill?
faq.answer: It includes both: a local tool builds and queries the graph, and agent instructions explain how to use it. They belong to one project overview.

faq.question: Is the graph a vector database?
faq.answer: The documented core uses a traversable knowledge graph rather than an embedding-based vector store. Relationships and paths are explicit parts of the output.

faq.question: Does all processing stay on the machine?
faq.answer: Local code parsing is deterministic AST analysis. Document and media interpretation can use a configured model backend; hosted services have their own data paths.

faq.question: What do EXTRACTED and INFERRED mean?
faq.answer: They distinguish direct source extraction from relationships resolved or inferred by Graphify. An inferred relationship should be checked before it supports a consequential conclusion.

faq.question: Can a saved graph become stale?
faq.answer: Yes. It represents the analyzed source state. Refresh it after relevant changes and preserve revision context when sharing findings.

faq.question: Does the open-source license include Graphify Cloud?
faq.answer: Apache-2.0 applies to the published local project. Hosted services, accounts, and model usage have separate access and commercial terms.

prerequisites.title: Choose Graphify’s processing boundary
prerequisites.description: Local AST processing and model-backed semantic tasks can handle source material differently. Identify which files remain local and which may reach a model or hosted service before investigation begins, rather than treating every graph operation as the same data path.

items.title: Choose local or hosted processing
items.description: Confirm which files stay in local AST processing and which semantic tasks use a model or hosted backend.

howTo.title: Build and verify a Graphify graph
howTo.description: Graph-based investigation needs the relevant tool and agent instructions available before the graph guides a change. Check the setup, follow a focused query, and compare its claims with current source files so the analysis remains tied to the revision being investigated.

items.title: Install the tool and agent guidance
items.description: The documented local package is graphifyy. Agent registration supplies instructions; confirm that the CLI and chosen integration are available.

items.title: Refresh and verify the graph
items.description: Rebuild or update after relevant source changes, and check the actual code before accepting a graph-derived claim.

en.seoDescription: Build queryable code graphs with Graphify’s local CLI and agent guidance. Keep relationships tied to source evidence and revisions when investigating a repository.

zh.seoTitle: Graphify：代码知识图谱、关系来源与 Agent 上下文
zh.description: Graphify 将代码和配套资料整理为可查询知识图谱。一起了解本地 CLI 与 Agent Skill，区分提取到的连接和推断关系，为仓库调查提供可以回到源文件核对的上下文。
overview: Graphify 将 Python 命令行工具与 Agent 指令结合，用于构建和查询知识图谱。开源项目由 Graphify Labs 维护。CLI 与 /graphify Skill 服务同一工作过程，因此在一个作品页中说明，避免建立相互竞争的同名介绍。
代码解析采用本地 AST 分析，文档或媒体的语义处理则可以使用助手模型或已配置后端。图谱区分直接提取的源代码连接与推断关系。图文件、交互视图和报告有助于导航，但推断边不能独立证明某种行为确实发生。
在 Floatboat 中研究仓库时，可以先用图谱定位相关文件和关系，再检查真实代码。图谱应与来源版本保持一致；Apache-2.0 本地工具和 Graphify 托管服务在配置、数据处理和商业条件上分别判断。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 把仓库结构整理成可导航上下文
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 解析关系、查询结果和语义推断各有不同来源。Graphify 可以帮助定位相关代码与文档，但结论还要回到引用文件核实，图上的联系不能自动升级为已经验证的程序行为。

capabilities.title: 提取代码中的明确连接
capabilities.description: 本地语法分析提取导入、调用等关系，为 Agent 调查代码库问题提供结构化起点。

capabilities.title: 查询与任务有关的子图
capabilities.description: 通过 query、path 和 explain 等操作选择相关上下文，减少把整库资料无差别塞入任务的需要。

capabilities.title: 保留关系的来源性质
capabilities.description: 提取与推断标签有助于区分直接证据，以及仍需进一步检查的关联。

useCases.title: Graphify的使用场景
useCases.description: 功能路径、重构影响和设计说明可能分别指向不同源文件。Graphify 帮助缩小调查范围后，判断仍需回到引用代码，并明确哪些联系来自推断、哪些行为已经有直接证据。

items.title: 定位功能背后的调用路径
items.description: 调查功能时，可以从入口、关键概念和限定的资料范围出发，沿图中关联的模块继续查找。提出修改前打开具体文件确认路径，将推断关系与源码已经证实的调用、实现位置区分开，避免直接把图上的连线当作行为事实。

items.title: 核对重构的边界
items.description: 结构性重构需要同时考虑调用方、依赖、公开接口和相关测试。确定修改边界前，将关联文档与代码一起检查，形成影响报告。报告应指出模块重新组织后仍需保持的接口约定和测试要求，而不是只列出准备移动的文件。

items.title: 连接代码与设计说明
items.description: 对照设计说明和代码时，将两类资料放入同一次调查，把设计主张对应到具体实现位置，并查看能够证实行为的文件。语义图推断需要单独说明，对证据缺口明确标记，避免把合理的关联直接报告为已经验证的实现事实。

items.title: 核验图中关系的来源
items.description: 图里的有用关联，可能来自明确代码结构，也可能来自语义推断。用它支持实现判断前，检查记录的来源及引用材料。缺少直接证据时，将推断连线保留为调查线索，并说明还需要核对什么，不把图谱本身当作行为已经成立的证明。

faq.question: Graphify 是软件还是 Skill？
faq.answer: 两者都有。本地工具负责构建和查询图谱，Agent 指令说明如何使用它们，适合在同一作品总览中介绍。

faq.question: 它使用向量数据库吗？
faq.answer: 官方核心说明采用可遍历知识图谱，而非基于 embedding 的向量存储，关系与路径是输出中的明确组成部分。

faq.question: 所有处理都留在本机吗？
faq.answer: 本地代码解析属于确定性 AST 分析；文档和媒体解释可能使用已配置模型后端，托管服务也有自己的数据路径。

faq.question: EXTRACTED 与 INFERRED 分别表示什么？
faq.answer: 它们区分直接从来源提取的关系和由 Graphify 解析或推断的关系。重要结论不能仅依赖未经核对的推断连接。

faq.question: 保存的图谱会过期吗？
faq.answer: 会。它对应某次分析时的来源状态，相关代码变化后需要刷新，共享调查结论时也应保留版本背景。

faq.question: 开源许可包含 Graphify Cloud 吗？
faq.answer: Apache-2.0 适用于公开本地项目；托管服务、账号和模型使用另有访问与商业条件。

prerequisites.title: 选择 Graphify 处理边界
prerequisites.description: 本地 AST 处理与模型支持的语义任务，可能采用不同资料路径。以下条件在调查前确认哪些文件留在本机、哪些可能发送到模型或托管服务，不把全部图谱操作理解为相同的数据处理。

items.title: 选择本地或托管处理
items.description: 核对哪些文件仅参与本地 AST 分析，哪些语义任务会调用模型或托管后端。

howTo.title: 构建并核对 Graphify 代码图谱
howTo.description: 图谱结论需要始终对应正在调查的源码版本。确认工具和 Agent 指引可用后，沿限定查询定位文件，再核对关系与行为，避免依据旧图或推断连线直接提出修改。

items.title: 准备工具与 Agent 指引
items.description: 官方本地包名为 graphifyy；注册 Agent 指令后，还应确认 CLI 与所选集成可用。

items.title: 刷新图谱并核对代码
items.description: 相关源文件变化后更新图谱，接受图谱导出的结论前再次检查实际代码。

zh.seoDescription: 通过 Graphify 本地 CLI 与 Agent 指引构建可查询代码图谱，调查仓库关系时保留证据来源和代码版本，区分图谱结果与推测，为项目理解和后续任务提供可核对上下文。

en.seoTitle: Orca: Parallel Coding Agents, Worktrees, and Review Loops
en.description: Orca brings multiple coding agents into one workspace, with separate Git worktrees and a shared review interface. Study task isolation, parallel comparisons, and diff feedback to organize agent work without confusing simultaneous execution with a verified result.
overview: Orca is a development workspace published in stablyai/orca. It organizes existing coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi alongside terminals, repository files, and review tools. It coordinates agent processes rather than supplying a new foundation model.

Each parallel task can use its own Git worktree. That separates file changes while the workspace provides a place to inspect diffs and send feedback. A mobile companion and SSH workflows extend how work is monitored or executed, but model access and remote-environment setup remain separate requirements.

For a Floatboat workflow, the useful pattern is to define bounded assignments, isolate changes, and compare evidence before accepting an implementation. Parallel agents still need a shared task contract and an explicit integration owner. Running in separate worktrees does not itself prevent mistakes, conflicts, or unauthorized actions.
en.capabilitiesTitle: Coordinate Independent Attempts and Review Their Results
en.capabilitiesIntro: Orca separates file isolation, review before integration, and observation across environments. Compare those responsibilities when coordinating agents, with clear task ownership and shared checks so parallel execution does not obscure who decides which changes enter the final result.

capabilities.title: Isolate file changes by task
capabilities.description: Assign worktrees to bounded tasks or competing approaches, so one agent does not silently overwrite another agent’s uncommitted files.

capabilities.title: Review changes before integration
capabilities.description: Use diffs and line-level comments to turn review findings into focused follow-ups, then inspect the revised result.

capabilities.title: Observe work across environments
capabilities.description: Desktop, companion, and SSH interfaces support different monitoring or execution arrangements. Choose the one that fits the actual environment.

useCases.title: Use Cases for Orca
useCases.description: Competing implementations, independent review, and parallel repository edits need comparable baselines. Explore Orca's coordination patterns through fixed revisions, isolated worktrees, and shared acceptance checks, with ownership and final integration decisions defined before work begins.

items.title: Compare two implementation approaches
items.description: Two implementation approaches are comparable only when they receive the same requirement and tests. Keep the attempts in isolated branches, then assess behavior, complexity, and verification evidence side by side. The fastest completion should not outweigh a result that better meets the shared acceptance conditions.

items.title: Separate implementation from review
items.description: Separate implementation from review with a fixed handoff revision and explicit acceptance conditions. Give the reviewer that code baseline and a focused question, then connect each finding and resolution to the revision being considered. This prevents review comments from drifting onto code that changed after the assessment began.

items.title: Work on distinct repository areas
items.description: Parallel repository work needs separable ownership boundaries, shared-interface rules, and an integration owner. Allocate worktrees or branches by those boundaries and agree on merge order before changes overlap. Joint checks at integration should verify that individually valid contributions still work together.

items.title: Keep a failed parallel attempt bounded
items.description: One agent's unsuccessful change should be assessed within its assigned files and revision rather than allowed to disturb unrelated work. Compare the branch result with the task brief, retain useful evidence, and decide separately whether to revise, defer, or discard that attempt. Use Orca's worktree coordination as a reference while keeping engine permissions and final integration decisions explicit.

faq.question: Which Orca project does this page describe?
faq.answer: The source is stablyai/orca, the high-star multi-agent development workspace. Other repositories named Orca are separate projects and should not be used as interchangeable installation sources.

faq.question: Does Orca replace Codex or Claude Code?
faq.answer: It organizes existing coding agents in a shared workbench. The selected engines still perform the model-driven work and retain their own account requirements.

faq.question: Do separate worktrees make parallel work safe automatically?
faq.answer: They isolate working files, but do not provide a complete security boundary or resolve shared-interface conflicts. Define permissions, task scope, and integration checks separately.

faq.question: Can agents use different models or providers?
faq.answer: The project supports multiple CLI agent engines. Exact models, quotas, and authentication depend on the selected engine and account.

faq.question: What is the mobile app for?
faq.answer: The documented companion lets a user monitor and steer work associated with a desktop host. It does not mean every provider engine runs directly on the phone.

faq.question: Should every task be sent to several agents?
faq.answer: No. Use parallel attempts when independent work or comparison is valuable. Shared mutable work and unclear acceptance criteria can add coordination cost without improving the result.

prerequisites.title: Prepare Orca engines and remote access
prerequisites.description: Each agent engine needs its own installation, authentication, and execution policy checked. Review remote or companion access separately from worktree isolation: independent file branches do not provide provider subscriptions or a security boundary for the processes running within them.

items.title: Confirm each agent’s setup
items.description: Install and authenticate the engines you intend to use. Source availability does not include provider subscriptions or unlimited model usage.

items.title: Inspect execution and remote access
items.description: Review the chosen engine’s approval settings and any SSH or companion connection. A worktree is file isolation, not a security boundary.

howTo.title: Integrate one reviewed Orca result
howTo.description: Parallel changes need more than individual agent completion before they can be combined. Review the proposed revisions, test the accepted set together, and make a separate merge decision so integration evidence reflects the actual version that would enter the repository.

items.title: Integrate one reviewed result
items.description: Choose the accepted change, run checks on the combined revision, and keep the merge decision explicit rather than equating task completion with approval.

en.seoDescription: Coordinate coding agents in separate worktrees with Orca. Compare their changes, review findings, and feed bounded follow-up tasks back into the development workflow.

zh.seoTitle: Orca：并行编程 Agent、独立 Worktree 与审阅循环
zh.description: Orca 将多个编程 Agent 放进同一工作台，通过独立 Git worktree 和统一审阅界面组织任务。了解任务隔离、并行方案比较与 diff 反馈，为自己的工作流明确执行分工和最终验收。
zh.kind: 多 Agent 开发工作台
overview: Orca 是 stablyai/orca 发布的开发工作台，将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 等已有编程 Agent 与终端、仓库文件和审阅工具组织在一起。它协调 Agent 进程，不提供新的基础模型。
并行任务可以使用各自的 Git worktree 隔离文件修改，再通过工作台查看 diff 并发送反馈。移动端伴侣与 SSH 工作流扩展了观察或执行工作的方式，但模型访问和远程环境准备仍是独立条件。
在 Floatboat 中设计工作流时，可以借鉴有边界的任务分派、修改隔离与结果比较。并行 Agent 仍需共同的任务约定和明确的集成负责人；仅使用不同 worktree，并不能自动避免错误、冲突或越权操作。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: 组织独立尝试，再审阅结果
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 文件隔离、工作观察和集成前审阅，分别回答 Orca 协作中的不同问题。任务由谁负责、结果按什么标准检查以及最终是否接受变更，都需要在并行执行之外保持明确。

capabilities.title: 按任务隔离文件修改
capabilities.description: 为独立任务或不同方案安排 worktree，避免一个 Agent 无意覆盖另一个 Agent 尚未提交的文件。

capabilities.title: 集成前检查实际修改
capabilities.description: 通过 diff 和行内评论把审阅发现转成明确的后续任务，再检查修订后的结果。

capabilities.title: 按环境选择观察入口
capabilities.description: 桌面、伴侣和 SSH 界面承担不同的监控与执行安排，应按实际环境选择。

useCases.title: Orca的使用场景
useCases.description: 独立方案需要相同测试才可比较，单独审阅需要固定版本，并行修改还要有集成负责人。Orca 的协调方式可供借鉴，让工作区、共同检查和最终接受决定保持对应。

items.title: 比较两种实现方案
items.description: 比较两种实现方案时，使用相同需求和测试，并将两次尝试放在隔离分支中。并排检查行为、复杂度和验证证据，让判断基于共同验收条件。完成速度可以作为观察项，但不能代替对结果正确性和维护成本的比较。

items.title: 分开实施与代码审阅
items.description: 将实施和审阅分开时，明确交接版本与验收条件。向审阅者提供固定代码基线和具体问题，并将每条发现及处理结果关联到该版本。这样可以避免审阅过程中代码继续变化，导致评论和实际接受的修改不再对应。

items.title: 并行处理不同仓库区域
items.description: 并行修改仓库时，需要可分离的责任范围、共享接口规则和最终集成负责人。按这些边界分配工作区或分支，并提前约定合并顺序。集成阶段进行联合检查，确认各自成立的修改放在一起之后仍然能够正常协作。

items.title: 限定失败的并行尝试范围
items.description: 某个 Agent 的修改没有成功时，应在分配给它的文件与版本范围内评估，不影响其他无关工作。将分支结果与任务说明比较，保留有用证据，再分别决定修订、暂缓还是放弃。参考 Orca 的工作区协调时，仍需明确引擎权限和最终集成决定。

faq.question: 这里介绍的是哪个 Orca？
faq.answer: 采用的是高 stars、多 Agent 开发工作台 stablyai/orca。同名仓库属于不同项目，不能作为可互换的安装来源。

faq.question: Orca 会替代 Codex 或 Claude Code 吗？
faq.answer: 它把现有编程 Agent 组织进共同工作台，实际模型任务仍由所选引擎执行，并沿用各自的账号条件。

faq.question: 使用不同 worktree 就自动安全吗？
faq.answer: 它们隔离工作文件，但不是完整安全边界，也不会自动解决共享接口冲突。权限、任务范围与集成检查仍需单独设计。

faq.question: 不同 Agent 可以用不同模型吗？
faq.answer: 项目支持多个 CLI Agent 引擎，具体模型、配额与认证方式取决于对应引擎和账号。

faq.question: 移动端应用负责什么？
faq.answer: 文档中的伴侣应用用于观察和跟进桌面宿主上的工作，不代表所有供应方引擎都直接运行在手机上。

faq.question: 是否应该把每项任务都发给多个 Agent？
faq.answer: 不需要。独立工作或方案比较有价值时才适合并行；共享修改和不清晰的验收标准可能增加协调成本。

prerequisites.title: 准备 Orca 引擎与远程访问
prerequisites.description: 每个 Agent 引擎都需要核对安装、认证与执行策略。以下条件将远程或伴随连接与工作区隔离分开；独立文件分支不提供服务订阅，也不构成进程运行的安全边界。

items.title: 确认每个 Agent 的运行条件
items.description: 安装并登录计划使用的引擎，源码公开不包含供应方订阅或无限模型额度。

items.title: 检查执行与远程访问设置
items.description: 核对所选引擎的审批模式，以及 SSH 或伴侣连接；worktree 隔离文件，但不构成安全隔离。

howTo.title: 整合一项审阅后的 Orca 结果
howTo.description: 各 Agent 分别完成，并不能证明组合后的代码仍然正确。先审阅拟议版本，再将已认可修改放入同一集成版本测试，最后单独决定合并，使证据对应实际进入仓库的结果。

items.title: 集成经过审阅的结果
items.description: 选择接受的修改后，对组合版本运行检查，并保留明确的合并决定，不能把任务完成等同于获准发布。

zh.seoDescription: 用 Orca 在独立 worktree 中组织并行编程 Agent，比较各自修改并审查问题，将发现转成范围明确的后续任务；了解隔离执行、结果整合与人工判断的分工。

en.seoTitle: NVIDIA Auto Ontology: Semantic Layer for Auditable Text-to-SQL
en.seoDescription: NVIDIA Auto Ontology maps business terms and reviewed metric SQL to database tables. Inspect generated queries and returned rows through read-only MCP.
en.description: NVIDIA Auto Ontology maps business terms, metrics, and table relationships to database evidence so agents can answer questions with SQL you can inspect.
en.overviewTitle: How NVIDIA Auto Ontology grounds database questions
overview: A question about revenue can be ambiguous even when the database is well documented. The agent needs to know which revenue definition applies, which tables can be joined, and which records to exclude. Auto Ontology compiles database metadata into a semantic layer that maps business terms to columns and relationships and can hold reviewed SQL for measures.

The project runs alongside the databases. Its chat interface can return the SQL, rows and steps behind an answer. Its read-only MCP server also exposes term lookup, answerability checks and questions to authenticated clients under the signed-in user's permissions. The companion setup, management and query Skills guide a coding agent through those operations.

When designing a Floatboat workflow for periodic reporting, use the ontology as a pattern for giving metrics an owner, a definition and a reproducible query. Start with a small test database and compare each result to an analyst-approved reference before treating the workflow as a source for decisions.
en.capabilitiesTitle: What Auto Ontology exposes to an agent
en.capabilitiesIntro: Follow a business question from the term it matched to the SQL and rows it produced. That gives an analyst separate places to check coverage, join logic and the underlying records.

capabilities.title: Business terms and reviewed measures
capabilities.description: Map terms to columns and attach reviewed SQL to measures whose business definitions need to be consistent.

capabilities.title: Relationships and query evidence
capabilities.description: Follow table relationships, inspect the generated SQL and compare the returned rows with a known result.

capabilities.title: Read-only MCP access
capabilities.description: Search terms and check whether a question is answerable before issuing it through a separately deployed, authenticated MCP server.

useCases.title: NVIDIA Auto Ontology use cases
useCases.description: Start with a question whose expected answer an analyst can reproduce. Use the SQL and rows to diagnose whether a mismatch comes from the definition, the join, the time window, or the underlying source.

items.title: Resolve two definitions of revenue
items.description: If finance reports net revenue and sales reports booked revenue, document the exclusions and approved query for each. Test the same monthly request against both measures and make the reporting agent surface the definition it selected.

items.title: Check joins before publishing a weekly KPI
items.description: Compare the generated order-to-invoice join against reference SQL using orders with multiple invoice lines. Review row counts and totals together so a plausible-looking aggregate does not hide duplicate records.

items.title: Route unsupported questions for review
items.description: Include a region or product attribute missing from the ontology in an evaluation set. Check answerability before asking for SQL, and capture the missing mapping for an analyst instead of filling the report with a guess.

items.title: Keep a reporting decision reproducible
items.description: Save the time window, approved measure, SQL and returned rows beside the result. When a source schema or definition changes, rerun the original question and give reviewers evidence for any difference.

prerequisites.title: What a test deployment needs
prerequisites.description: The upstream quickstart uses Microsoft’s Wide World Importers sample. Its Docker Compose configuration runs the supporting services, while the configured inference endpoints and credentials are managed separately.

items.title: Local runtime
items.description: Install Docker with Compose v2 and uv for the upstream sample setup.

items.title: Model endpoint access
items.description: Set the credentials for your configured inference endpoints. The documented sample quickstart uses an NVIDIA API key.

items.title: Database scope
items.description: Start with the sample database or an approved test source and restrict the credentials to the data needed for the task.

faq.question: What does the ontology store?
faq.answer: It connects business terms, columns, table relationships and SQL definitions. The underlying records stay in the connected data sources.

faq.question: Which SQL has been reviewed, and which SQL do I still need to check?
faq.answer: A data owner can review the SQL attached to a measure. The query generated for a particular question still needs to be checked against the requested time window, joins and returned rows.

faq.question: Can an MCP client change my ontology?
faq.answer: The upstream MCP server exposes read-only tools. Authenticate with the deployment and review its account permissions before testing.

faq.question: What if a metric is missing?
faq.answer: Use the answerability tools to identify missing coverage and ask a data owner to define or approve the metric before using it in reporting.

faq.question: What are the NVIDIA ontology Skills for?
faq.answer: They guide setup, semantic model management and validated querying. The query workflow depends on a running Auto Ontology deployment.

faq.question: Does the sample setup need model credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. NVIDIA documents an API key for the sample quickstart. Check the model endpoint and credential requirements when changing the configuration.

zh.seoTitle: NVIDIA Auto Ontology：企业数据语义层与可核验的文本转 SQL
zh.seoDescription: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 将业务术语、指标定义和表关系交给 Agent。用示例库核对生成的 SQL、返回行和连接条件，并查看只读 MCP 怎样判断问题是否在语义层的覆盖范围内。
zh.description: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 把业务术语、指标口径和表关系映射到数据库，让 Agent 回答数据问题时给出可以核对的 SQL。
zh.overviewTitle: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 如何为数据库问答提供依据
overview: 同一句“上个月收入是多少”，财务和销售可能采用不同口径。Agent 要先理解收入的定义、哪些表可以连接，以及哪些记录应排除。Auto Ontology 从数据库元数据编译语义层，将术语映射到列与表关系，并可为指标保存审核过的 SQL。
项目部署在数据库旁。聊天界面可以返回答案背后的 SQL、结果行和执行步骤；只读 MCP 服务还向已认证的客户端提供术语查询、可回答性检查和问答工具，调用遵循登录用户的权限。配套的三个 Skills 分别覆盖部署、语义模型管理和查询验证。
如果在 Floatboat 里设计定期报表，可以借鉴这套方法，为指标保存责任人、定义和可复跑查询。先在测试库里选几个分析师可以独立复算的问题，把结果逐项核对清楚，再决定哪些指标可以交给 Agent。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Auto Ontology 给 Agent 提供哪些数据依据
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 业务问题先对应到术语和指标定义，再沿表关系生成查询。比对 SQL 与返回行时，可以把口径、连接条件和数据质量分开排查。

capabilities.title: 业务术语与指标口径
capabilities.description: 将术语映射到实际字段，为需要统一定义的度量绑定审核过的 SQL。

capabilities.title: 表关系与查询证据
capabilities.description: 查看查询经过哪些表及连接条件，并将返回行与已知结果对照。

capabilities.title: 只读 MCP 工具
capabilities.description: 通过独立部署并完成认证后，可以先查术语和可回答性，再执行有依据的数据问答。

useCases.title: NVIDIA Auto Ontology 的使用场景
useCases.description: 选一个分析师可以独立复算的问题，固定数据快照与统计周期。若结果有出入，先查指标定义，再查表连接和返回行，避免多个变量同时变化。

items.title: 对齐财务与销售的收入口径
items.description: 财务可能按净收入统计，销售则关注已签订单金额。分别记录两个指标的计算口径、排除项和参考 SQL，再对同一个月复算，并在报表标出实际采用的指标。

items.title: 检查关联查询是否重复计数
items.description: 选取包含多行发票明细的订单，比较生成查询与人工确认的订单到发票连接。先核对行数，再核对汇总金额，避免误把重复记录算进周报。

items.title: 将缺少定义的问题交回分析师
items.description: 在评估集中加入语义层没有覆盖的地区或产品属性，查询前先检查是否可回答。记录缺失的字段映射，由数据负责人补齐后再生成指标。

items.title: 为定期报表留下复核材料
items.description: 把统计区间、指标定义、实际 SQL 与返回行随报表存档。数据库字段或定义调整后重跑相同问题，审阅人可以追查数字变化从何而来。

prerequisites.title: 运行示例前要准备什么
prerequisites.description: 官方示例使用微软的 Wide World Importers 数据库。Docker Compose 启动配套服务，推理端点和凭据则按选用的模型单独配置。

items.title: 本地运行环境
items.description: 按上游快速入门准备 Docker、Compose v2 和 uv。

items.title: 推理端点凭据
items.description: 为所选推理端点配置凭据。上游示例使用 NVIDIA API 密钥。

items.title: 测试数据范围
items.description: 先使用示例库或获准的测试数据源，并将数据库账号限制在任务所需范围内。

faq.question: 本体层里保存了什么？
faq.answer: 保存业务术语、字段映射、表关系和指标的 SQL 定义。实际记录仍存放在连接的数据源中。

faq.question: 哪些 SQL 已经过审核，哪些还需要自己核对？
faq.answer: 数据负责人可以审核指标关联的 SQL 定义。针对某个问题生成的实际查询仍要核对统计周期、表连接与返回行，再和参考结果比较。

faq.question: MCP 客户端可以修改本体吗？
faq.answer: 上游 MCP 提供只读工具。连接需要经过部署实例认证，测试前可核对该账户的数据权限。

faq.question: 语义层没有覆盖我的指标怎么办？
faq.answer: 先检查问题是否可回答，找出缺少的术语、字段或定义。由指标负责人确认后再把结果用于报表。

faq.question: 三个 NVIDIA Ontology Skills 分别做什么？
faq.answer: 分别指导部署、语义模型管理和验证查询。执行查询前需要可用的 Auto Ontology 实例。

faq.question: 运行官方示例需要模型凭据吗？
faq.answer: 需要。上游快速入门使用 NVIDIA API 密钥，改用其他端点时需核对相应的认证配置。

en.seoTitle: Craft Anything: Software Inspection and AI Rebuild Checks
en.seoDescription: Capture visible behavior with Craft Anything and brief a coding agent. Compare rebuilt websites across screen widths and check early-alpha and Deep mode limits.
en.description: Craft Anything collects evidence from software you are allowed to study, passes a brief to a coding agent, and compares the new implementation against the reference.
en.overviewTitle: From software observation to a testable rebuild
overview: A screenshot captures one moment. It leaves out mobile layouts, open menus and the behavior that makes a prototype useful. Craft Anything is an early-alpha Rust project that records observations and puts them alongside a new implementation and its comparison results. The desktop app, CLI and MCP interface expose the same underlying engine.

The default clean-room mode studies visible behavior, such as text, screenshots, spacing and menu states. Deep mode can inspect internals such as files or code when you are authorized to examine them. The mode does not isolate the operating system, and a coding agent still acts with its own permissions.

The useful pattern for a Floatboat workflow is to turn observable evidence into a brief and a set of acceptance checks. Choose assets and interactions you have permission to reuse, keep references separate from generated files, and record differences you want to fix or keep.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Craft Anything connects evidence and implementation
en.capabilitiesIntro: The project folder separates the capture, new implementation, and comparison results. Those artifacts make it possible to revisit one mismatch without reopening every design choice.

capabilities.title: Capture visible states
capabilities.description: Record pages at several widths, visible text, layout measurements and open controls to specify what the new project needs to do.

capabilities.title: Delegate the build
capabilities.description: Give an installed coding agent a brief and target stack. Upstream documents Claude Code as the first supported builder.

capabilities.title: Compare the result
capabilities.description: Review viewport checks and remaining mismatches against the source evidence, then decide which differences need another pass.

useCases.title: Craft Anything use cases
useCases.description: Choose a target you can examine and a small set of behaviors worth reproducing. The handoff should identify what was observed, where the brief leaves room for judgment, and how to evaluate the result.

items.title: Replace an internal page with a responsive prototype
items.description: Capture the current layout at desktop, tablet and phone widths, including a collapsed navigation state. Ask the builder to use your own copy and assets, then check overflow, element order and menu behavior at all three widths.

items.title: Document the behavior of a retiring desktop tool
items.description: Work from a permitted copy and record how the window changes after an import, an empty file or a failed action. Turn the observations into acceptance cases for a replacement and list any behavior you could not reproduce.

items.title: Rebuild a game mechanic as a small experiment
items.description: Choose a mechanic you may study, such as a movement or scoring loop, and describe it using your own art and level design. Treat a runnable demo and a repeatable gameplay check as the handoff, with unresolved differences listed separately.

items.title: Separate regressions from approved design changes
items.description: After reviewing a comparison, approve the intentional differences in writing and turn the rest into small fix requests. Rerun the affected checks so later reviewers can tell a deliberate redesign from an unresolved mismatch.

prerequisites.title: What to prepare before a Craft Anything run
prerequisites.description: Start with a target you are authorized to inspect and a separate project folder. Confirm your platform’s release and your coding agent before committing to a larger rebuild.

items.title: A reference you may study
items.description: Define what can be captured and what assets, copy or branding require separate permission.

items.title: A build agent for implementation
items.description: Check the supported backend in the upstream status notes. Claude Code uses its own local installation and sign-in.

items.title: A testable project scope
items.description: Pick representative screens or states and write down how you will compare them. Early-alpha support varies by target and tool.

faq.question: What can the default clean-room mode see?
faq.answer: It uses visible evidence such as screenshots, text and measured layout. Deep mode is separate and may inspect internals where you have permission.

faq.question: Does clean-room mode sandbox the builder?
faq.answer: The mode controls what Craft Anything offers for inspection. The operating system and coding agent keep their own permission boundaries.

faq.question: Is Craft Anything ready for production migration?
faq.answer: Upstream labels it early alpha. Pilot with a bounded target and verify the particular platform, agent and comparison tools you intend to rely on.

faq.question: Can I inspect a project without starting a build?
faq.answer: Yes. The upstream app provides an inspection-only path in Deep mode, and the CLI and MCP interfaces expose inspection tools.

faq.question: Can I use Codex as the builder?
faq.answer: Upstream documents a Codex adapter but says it has not verified it on a real installation. Check the current status before depending on it.

faq.question: Does the source license cover the target’s assets?
faq.answer: Craft Anything is offered under MIT or Apache-2.0. A target's logos, text, images and other materials keep their own rights.

zh.seoTitle: Craft Anything：软件界面取证、AI 重建与差异验收
zh.seoDescription: Craft Anything 从获准研究的软件记录界面与交互，交给编程 Agent 重建，并对照重建网页在不同屏宽下的表现。项目处于早期 Alpha，Deep 模式的内部检查需要单独确认权限。
zh.description: Craft Anything 从获准研究的软件采集界面与行为证据，把任务交给编程 Agent，再将新的实现与参考对象逐项比较。
zh.overviewTitle: 把软件观察结果变成可验收的重建任务
overview: 一张截图只记录某一刻的界面，无法说明窄屏怎样排版、菜单怎样展开，或导入失败后出现什么。Craft Anything 是早期 Alpha 的 Rust 项目，将观察记录、新实现和对照结果放在同一项目里。桌面应用、CLI 和 MCP 共用底层引擎。
默认的洁净室模式从可见行为取证，例如截图、文字、间距和展开的菜单。Deep 模式可以进一步查看文件或代码等内部信息，前提是你有权查看。模式本身不会隔离操作系统，编程 Agent 仍使用自己的读写和执行权限。
在 Floatboat 里构建类似工作流时，可以把观察记录整理成任务书和验收项。选用有权使用的素材和交互，将参考资料与生成文件分开，逐条标明哪些差异要修、哪些可以保留。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Craft Anything 如何把观察结果交给编程 Agent
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 项目目录分别保存观察记录、新实现和对照结果。遇到界面差异时，可以回到原始截图、布局尺寸或交互状态，决定是修正实现还是保留设计调整。

capabilities.title: 记录多个界面状态
capabilities.description: 保存不同屏宽下的页面、可见文字、布局尺寸与控件展开状态，为重建说明补上单张截图遗漏的细节。

capabilities.title: 将实现交给编程 Agent
capabilities.description: 提供任务说明和目标技术栈，由本机编程 Agent 生成项目。上游首先支持 Claude Code。

capabilities.title: 用对照结果决定下一轮修改
capabilities.description: 检查各屏宽下的结果与原参考之间还有哪些差异，再决定需要修改的交互或布局。

useCases.title: Craft Anything 的使用场景
useCases.description: 从获准研究的参考对象里选出关键行为，例如窄屏菜单或导入错误。交接时把实际观察、可自行决定的设计细节和验收动作分别记录。

items.title: 为内部页面做响应式替代原型
items.description: 采集桌面、平板和手机布局，另外记录导航折叠后的状态。重建时使用自己的文案和素材，交付前检查三种屏宽下的溢出、元素顺序和菜单操作。

items.title: 记录准备退役的桌面工具
items.description: 在获准使用的副本中，观察导入正常文件、空文件和失败后的界面变化。把这些现象转成替代工具的验收用例，同时标出没有复现的行为。

items.title: 单独试做一种游戏机制
items.description: 选取有权研究的移动或计分循环，用自己的美术和关卡表达。交付一个可运行的演示和可重复的玩法检查，将仍有差异的地方单独列出。

items.title: 分清主动改版和未修复的偏差
items.description: 看过对照结果后，先确认哪些变化是有意保留的，再把其余差异拆成可复测的小任务。复查受影响的屏幕或状态，让后续审阅有据可查。

prerequisites.title: 运行 Craft Anything 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 先准备获准检查的目标和独立项目目录，再核对平台发行版、编程 Agent 与所需的对照工具。只研究界面时，可以先把范围限制在可见证据。

items.title: 可用于取证的参考对象
items.description: 明确允许记录的范围，并列出需要另行授权的素材、文案或品牌元素。

items.title: 本机编程 Agent
items.description: 按上游状态说明核对后端。Claude Code 使用自己的本机安装与登录。

items.title: 可验证的任务边界
items.description: 选择有代表性的屏幕或状态，先写清比较方法。早期 Alpha 对不同目标和工具的覆盖程度有差异。

faq.question: 默认的洁净室模式能看到哪些信息？
faq.answer: 它使用截图、可见文字和布局尺寸等外部证据。需要查看有权检查的内部信息时，再切换到 Deep 模式。

faq.question: 洁净室模式会隔离编程 Agent 吗？
faq.answer: 这个模式限制 Craft Anything 提供的取证方式。操作系统和编程 Agent 仍按各自的权限执行。

faq.question: 可以直接用于正式迁移吗？
faq.answer: 上游将项目标为早期 Alpha。先用范围小的目标试跑，核对所选平台、Agent 和对照工具是否覆盖实际任务。

faq.question: 只想研究软件，可以先不重建吗？
faq.answer: 可以。上游桌面应用在 Deep 模式下提供仅检查的入口，CLI 与 MCP 也提供独立的取证工具。

faq.question: Codex 能直接作为重建的 Agent 吗？
faq.answer: 上游提供 Codex 适配器，但说明尚未在真实安装中验证。依赖这个流程前应查看对应版本的状态。

faq.question: 项目开源许可包含参考软件的素材吗？
faq.answer: Craft Anything 源码可选 MIT 或 Apache-2.0。参考软件的标志、文字、图片等仍有各自的权利边界。

en.seoTitle: OpenCut: Classic Browser Editing and the Rust Rewrite
en.seoDescription: Try timeline editing in the OpenCut Classic browser beta. Check import and export with your own clips, and distinguish the Rust rewrite from planned MCP features.
en.description: OpenCut is an open-source video editor for timeline-based work. The browser beta uses Classic while the team builds a new Rust-based editor.
en.overviewTitle: OpenCut Classic and the Rust rewrite
overview: OpenCut is a timeline editor positioned as an open-source alternative to CapCut. Its public browser beta runs the original Classic codebase. The team archives that code separately while building the next version in the main repository.
