useCases.title: Skyvern 使用场景
useCases.description: 以下流程关注可重复业务结果，而不只关注页面导航。增加运行频率、批量规模或 Agent 权限前，先使用样例记录与可观察检查点，核对字段、错误和最终交付物。

items.title: 填写可重复的门户记录
items.description: 提供获准测试记录与目标表单，建立填写一条记录并在最终提交前暂停的流程，对照输入检查字段值，扩大批量前先验证异常路径。

items.title: 跟踪周期流程运行
items.description: 提供既有流程标识与一次运行的预期输出，通过获准工具检查完成和错误状态，再核对文档或记录。运行完成仍可能产生错误业务值。

items.title: 收集结构化门户结果
items.description: 使用获准账号进入指定报表，返回所需字段及来源上下文。将登录、日期选择与提取分别记录，避免过期页面成为错误周期的报告。

items.title: 比较本地与云端运行
items.description: 在选定后端执行无敏感的小型流程，记录配置、输出与依赖服务。按数据访问和运营需要选择部署，不假定自托管免除模型费用，也不假定云端继承本地登录。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Skyvern 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 先选择托管或自部署方式，再按该入口准备账号、运行环境和流程权限。

items.title: 选定后端
items.description: 准备云端认证或文档中的自托管服务栈及模型、浏览器配置。

items.title: 流程输入
items.description: 使用测试记录，运行生产任务前明确会话创建与提交检查点。

faq.question: Skyvern 有 Cursor／Codex 入口吗？
faq.answer: 有。官方 MCP 文档列明两者及本地、云端配置，除客户端条目之外还需准备后端与会话。

faq.question: 流程与浏览器会话相同吗？
faq.answer: 不同。会话提供浏览器状态，流程描述动作序列与输入，运行和诊断时需分别保留标识及输出检查。

faq.question: 后端可以自托管吗？
faq.answer: 项目提供自托管路径，需要运行环境、浏览器、模型与认证，单独本地 MCP 包装不能替代完整后端。

faq.question: 官方 Skill 增加什么？
faq.answer: 它指导编码 Agent 使用当前 Skyvern CLI 与 MCP，不替代服务端、账号和结果验收，并应与安装版本匹配。

faq.question: 流程何时应暂停并交给用户确认？
faq.answer: 将关键提交、账号变更与购买设为明确检查点，先用草稿或测试数据验证，再允许作用于生产记录。

faq.question: 源码许可与服务费有什么区别？
faq.answer: 源码采用 AGPL-3.0，托管访问和模型使用有独立条款与费用，需核对部署和分发要求，不能将源码许可等同于免费托管服务。

en.seoTitle: Steel Browser: Browser Sessions, MCP Access, and Agent Skills
en.seoDescription: Use Steel to provide a browser session for agent work. Compare the open-source browser runtime with Steel’s hosted MCP and official Skills, keeping service authentication and session costs explicit.
en.description: Use Steel to provide a browser session for agent work. Compare the open-source browser runtime with Steel’s hosted MCP and official Skills, keeping service authentication and session costs explicit.
overview: Steel Browser is open-source browser infrastructure rather than a task-planning agent. It supplies sessions and browser connectivity that an agent or application can drive. Its ecosystem includes a hosted MCP service and official Skills for live browser work, reusable code, and session diagnosis.

The hosted MCP documentation gives Cursor and Codex configuration and authentication steps. That service is not automatically installed when the open-source browser server is started. The official steel-browser Skill targets Steel cloud browser work; follow the path whose account and runtime you actually have.

The steel-browser repository uses Apache-2.0. Cloud credentials, session time, and connected model services remain separate considerations. For Floatboat, use the documented external-agent MCP or Skill workflow and verify the created session before passing private data or reusing a profile.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Steel Browser Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: Steel separates browser infrastructure from the logic that drives it. Choose a session backend, the official operating or developer guidance, and a session cleanup and release plan before treating a browser connection as a reusable workflow.

capabilities.title: Session infrastructure
capabilities.description: Create a browser session and connect an automation client rather than running a separate task-planning model.

capabilities.title: Hosted MCP connection
capabilities.description: Use the service’s documented host configuration and authentication for live agent access.

capabilities.title: Task-specific official Skills
capabilities.description: Separate operating a browser, writing Steel code, and diagnosing a failed session.

useCases.title: Steel Browser Use Cases
useCases.description: Session provisioning, reusable scripts, failure diagnosis, and runtime placement are different infrastructure decisions. Keep the selected service and evidence visible so a cloud assumption does not silently enter a local deployment.

items.title: Provide a browser to an existing agent
items.description: When the agent already knows the task, create a Steel session through the chosen service and connect its supported tools. Verify the target URL and session identity before performing actions. The browser infrastructure does not decide which business operations the agent is allowed to perform.

items.title: Turn a successful lookup into code
items.description: Use the official developer guidance to turn a verified browser lookup into a maintained script. Record session creation, connection, extraction, and cleanup, then run the same input again. Reusable code needs explicit error and output handling beyond a successful interactive session.

items.title: Diagnose a failed hosted session
items.description: Bring the session identifier and the point where the task stopped. Compare logs, traces, or replay evidence available in the selected service to distinguish connection failure from application behavior. Redact credentials and do not infer the cause from a generic timeout alone.

items.title: Evaluate browser runtime placement
items.description: For a non-sensitive extraction task, compare the operational needs of the open-source server and hosted service. Record which components run where and how the agent connects. A self-hosted runtime and a hosted MCP subscription are different deployment choices, not interchangeable installation commands.

prerequisites.title: Before Using Steel Browser
prerequisites.description: The open-source browser server and hosted MCP have different setup requirements. Confirm where the browser will run before configuring the agent.

items.title: Cloud or self-hosted choice
items.description: Choose the open-source server or hosted service and prepare the corresponding credentials and connection method.

items.title: Session lifecycle
items.description: Plan session creation, output inspection, and release, including service limits and billing conditions.

faq.question: Is Steel an autonomous browser agent?
faq.answer: The browser infrastructure supplies sessions and connectivity. An agent or application supplies task reasoning and actions; the hosted MCP and Skills are ways to connect that existing host.

faq.question: Does running steel-browser provide hosted MCP?
faq.answer: No. The open-source server and Steel’s hosted MCP are distinct deployment surfaces. Use the service documentation for its authentication and client setup rather than assuming a local container supplies them.

faq.question: Which Skill should I choose?
faq.answer: The official repository distinguishes steel-browser for live work, steel-developer for code, and steel-session-debugging for failed runs. Choose the job first instead of installing every instruction indiscriminately.

faq.question: Can Cursor, Codex, and Floatboat connect?
faq.answer: The hosted MCP documentation lists Cursor and Codex. Floatboat can use the corresponding MCP path with the service’s account and authentication requirements; it is not a bundled browser entitlement.

faq.question: Does Apache-2.0 include free cloud sessions?
faq.answer: No. The source license governs the repository code. Hosted browser sessions, service limits, and model use follow their own terms, even when an open-source client connects to them.

faq.question: What should be saved after a session?
faq.answer: Keep the requested output, source URL, session identifier, and verification result where appropriate. Close or release the session according to the service so a finished task does not leave infrastructure running unintentionally.

zh.seoTitle: Steel Browser：浏览器会话、MCP 接入与 Agent Skills
zh.seoDescription: 通过 Steel 为 Agent 工作提供浏览器会话，区分开源运行环境、托管 MCP 与官方 Skills，并明确服务认证和会话费用。
zh.description: 通过 Steel 为 Agent 工作提供浏览器会话，区分开源运行环境、托管 MCP 与官方 Skills，并明确服务认证和会话费用。
zh.kind: 浏览器基础设施与服务
overview: Steel Browser 是开源浏览器基础设施，不是任务规划 Agent。它提供供 Agent 或应用驱动的会话与浏览器连接，生态中另有托管 MCP 和用于现场操作、复用代码及会话诊断的官方 Skills。
托管 MCP 文档提供 Cursor、Codex 配置及认证步骤。启动开源浏览器服务并不会自动安装该托管服务。官方 steel-browser Skill 面向 Steel 云浏览器任务，应根据实际账号和运行环境选择路径。
steel-browser 仓库采用 Apache-2.0，云端凭据、会话时长与连接模型服务需分别考虑。Floatboat 可采用文档中的外部 Agent MCP 或 Skill 流程，传入私有数据或复用配置前先验证创建的会话。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Steel Browser 在浏览器流程中的作用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: Steel 将浏览器基础设施与驱动逻辑分开。建立可复用流程前，先选择会话后端、对应操作或开发指引，并明确释放方式，不把连接成功当作任务已具备运行条件。

capabilities.title: 会话基础设施
capabilities.description: 创建浏览器会话并连接自动化客户端，无需将其理解为另一任务规划模型。

capabilities.title: 托管 MCP 连接
capabilities.description: 按服务文档配置宿主与认证，实现实时 Agent 接入。

capabilities.title: 按任务划分的官方 Skills
capabilities.description: 区分操作浏览器、编写 Steel 代码与诊断失败会话。

useCases.title: Steel Browser 使用场景
useCases.description: 会话提供、复用脚本、失败诊断与运行位置属于不同基础设施决定。需要记录所选服务和证据，避免将云端假设带入本地部署，也不把本地条件套用于托管 MCP。

items.title: 为现有 Agent 提供浏览器
items.description: Agent 已有任务时，通过选定服务创建 Steel 会话并连接工具。先核对目标 URL 与会话身份再操作，浏览器基础设施并不决定业务动作是否获准。

items.title: 将成功查询转成代码
items.description: 按官方开发指引将已验证浏览器查询改为维护脚本，记录会话创建、连接、提取和清理，再用相同输入复跑。复用代码还需明确错误及输出处理。

items.title: 诊断失败的托管会话
items.description: 提供会话标识与停止位置，结合所选服务的日志、轨迹或回放区分连接故障和应用行为。凭据需隐藏，不能仅凭通用超时推断原因。

items.title: 评估浏览器运行位置
items.description: 针对无敏感提取任务，比较开源服务与托管服务的运行要求，记录组件位置及 Agent 连接方式。自托管运行环境与托管 MCP 订阅是不同部署选择，不能混用安装命令。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Steel Browser 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 开源浏览器服务与托管 MCP 的配置要求不同，先确定浏览器在哪里运行，再配置 Agent 连接。

items.title: 选择云端或自托管
items.description: 选择开源服务或托管服务，准备对应凭据与连接方式。

items.title: 会话生命周期
items.description: 明确会话创建、输出检查与释放，以及服务限制和计费条件。

faq.question: Steel 是自主浏览器 Agent 吗？
faq.answer: 浏览器基础设施提供会话与连接，任务推理和动作来自 Agent 或应用；托管 MCP 和 Skills 用于连接现有宿主。

faq.question: 运行 steel-browser 就有托管 MCP 吗？
faq.answer: 不是。开源服务与 Steel 托管 MCP 是不同部署入口，托管认证与客户端配置应查服务文档，不能假定本地容器已提供。

faq.question: 应该选择哪个 Skill？
faq.answer: 官方区分现场工作的 steel-browser、编写代码的 steel-developer，以及失败运行的 steel-session-debugging，应按任务选择。

faq.question: Cursor、Codex 与 Floatboat 可以连接吗？
faq.answer: 托管 MCP 文档列出 Cursor、Codex，Floatboat 可按对应 MCP 路径使用，需满足账号与认证要求，不代表内置浏览器额度。

faq.question: Apache-2.0 包含免费云会话吗？
faq.answer: 不包含。源码许可管理仓库代码，托管会话、服务限制和模型使用有自己的条款，开源客户端连接也不改变这一点。

faq.question: 会话后需要保存什么？
faq.answer: 按需要保留输出、来源 URL、会话标识及验证结果，并按服务要求关闭或释放会话，避免任务结束后仍无意占用运行资源。

en.seoTitle: Bright Data MCP: Connect Agents to Web Access and Extraction
en.seoDescription: Connect a coding agent to Bright Data’s web access and data tools. Use its official Skills to choose browser, fetch, search, or extraction workflows, with credentials, product scope, and costs checked separately.
en.description: Connect a coding agent to Bright Data’s web access and data tools. Use its official Skills to choose browser, fetch, search, or extraction workflows, with credentials, product scope, and costs checked separately.
overview: Bright Data MCP is a service connector rather than a standalone local browser. It exposes web access and data capabilities from Bright Data to an MCP client. Browser operation is one possible task alongside search, page fetching, and structured data extraction, so select the relevant product surface first.

Official client examples include Cursor, and the Bright Data CLI can configure agent connections. The separate official Skills repository covers onboarding, browsing, scraping, fetching, and cost checks. Choose MCP for tools exposed to an agent client, CLI for terminal workflows, or an SDK for application code.

Prepare an authorized service account and the product access needed by the task. The MCP repository is MIT-licensed, while service use, data products, and usage charges follow Bright Data’s terms. A local MCP process still calls external infrastructure, so do not describe it as local-only data processing.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Bright Data MCP Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: Bright Data exposes several products through agent interfaces. Choose the output first, then the service, authentication, and usage limits; MCP connectivity alone does not select a suitable collection or browser workflow.

capabilities.title: Select a data access surface
capabilities.description: Match search, fetching, browser work, or ready data products to the requested output.

capabilities.title: Official agent onboarding
capabilities.description: Use official Skills and CLI guidance to configure the service without putting keys in the task text.

capabilities.title: Usage-aware workflows
capabilities.description: Check service access and cost conditions before expanding a small collection into a batch.

useCases.title: Bright Data MCP Use Cases
useCases.description: Public extraction, search, interactive browsing, and ready data products require different tools and checks. Start with a bounded sample and keep evidence, freshness, and cost decisions separate from connection setup.

items.title: Collect public product fields
items.description: Provide a small list of public product pages and the fields needed for comparison. Select an appropriate extraction or fetching tool, preserve source URLs, and record missing values. Check the cost and output of the sample before authorizing a wider collection.

items.title: Search before opening many pages
items.description: For a research question, use the appropriate search surface to identify likely sources, then inspect a bounded subset. Return queries, selected URLs, and the facts they support rather than treating search snippets as verified page content.

items.title: Operate a cloud browser
items.description: When an interaction genuinely needs a browser, use the relevant Bright Data browser service and configured agent tools. Identify the session and expected page result, then verify the action. A simple fetch task should not be described as having exercised the interactive workflow.

items.title: Choose existing data over recrawling
items.description: If a ready data product may answer the request, compare coverage, freshness, and access terms before launching a new crawl. Present the choice and cost implications for review; neither an MCP connection nor a Skill authorizes purchases automatically.

prerequisites.title: Before Using Bright Data MCP
prerequisites.description: Match the service product, account access, and usage budget to the data task before connecting an agent.

items.title: Service account and product access
items.description: Configure the relevant Bright Data product and authentication through official onboarding or client settings.

items.title: Collection scope and costs
items.description: Set a bounded sample, required fields, and usage limits before running a larger job.

faq.question: Is Bright Data MCP a free standalone scraper?
faq.answer: No. It connects agents to Bright Data services. The MIT repository license covers connector code, not unrestricted service use, data purchases, or browser-session allowance.

faq.question: Are official Skills available?
faq.answer: Yes. brightdata/skills contains onboarding and task-specific instructions. They can guide CLI, MCP, or SDK use, but the requested service still needs an account and appropriate access.

faq.question: How should credentials be supplied?
faq.answer: Use the documented client or CLI authentication configuration. Keep API tokens out of task text, generated reports, and source control; a user may need to approve the service login.

faq.question: Does every task need a browser?
faq.answer: No. Search, fetch, datasets, and extraction can serve different outputs. Reserve interactive browser operations for tasks that require page state or actions rather than assuming browsing is always necessary.

faq.question: Can a local MCP keep the task offline?
faq.answer: No. The local connector still calls Bright Data’s infrastructure and the host may use a remote model. Review service and model data paths for the content you plan to submit.

faq.question: What should a collection report include?
faq.answer: Record source URLs, retrieval context, required fields, missing values, and relevant usage information. Validate samples against source pages before treating a returned JSON structure as trustworthy data.

zh.seoTitle: Bright Data MCP：将 Agent 连接到网页访问与提取服务
zh.seoDescription: 将编码 Agent 连接到 Bright Data 网页访问与数据工具，通过官方 Skills 选择浏览器、获取、搜索或提取流程，并分别核对凭据、产品范围及成本。
zh.description: 将编码 Agent 连接到 Bright Data 网页访问与数据工具，通过官方 Skills 选择浏览器、获取、搜索或提取流程，并分别核对凭据、产品范围及成本。
zh.kind: 网页数据 MCP 服务连接器
overview: Bright Data MCP 是服务连接器，不是独立本地浏览器。它向 MCP 客户端提供 Bright Data 的网页访问与数据能力，浏览器操作只是其中一种任务，还包括搜索、获取页面和结构化提取，应先选择对应产品入口。
官方客户端示例包含 Cursor，Bright Data CLI 也可配置 Agent 连接。独立官方 Skills 仓库覆盖引导、浏览、采集、获取与成本检查。需要 Agent 客户端调用工具时选择 MCP，终端流程使用 CLI，应用代码则采用 SDK。
准备获准服务账号及任务对应产品权限。MCP 仓库采用 MIT，服务、数据产品和用量费用遵循 Bright Data 条款。本地 MCP 进程仍调用外部基础设施，不能写成只在本机处理数据。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Bright Data MCP 在浏览器流程中的作用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: Bright Data 通过 Agent 接口提供多种产品，应先确定输出，再选择服务、认证和用量限制。MCP 连通不自动选择适合的采集或浏览器流程，也不批准额外费用。

capabilities.title: 选择数据访问入口
capabilities.description: 按输出选择搜索、页面获取、浏览器工作或现成数据产品。

capabilities.title: 官方 Agent 引导
capabilities.description: 使用官方 Skills 与 CLI 指引配置服务，不将密钥写入任务文本。

capabilities.title: 关注用量的流程
capabilities.description: 将小规模收集扩大为批量之前，先核对服务权限与费用条件。

useCases.title: Bright Data MCP 使用场景
useCases.description: 公开提取、搜索、交互浏览和现成数据产品需要不同工具与检查。先限定样本，将证据、新鲜度和成本决定与连接配置分开，并在扩大范围前验证实际输出。

items.title: 收集公开产品字段
items.description: 提供少量公开产品页与比较字段，选择适用提取或获取工具，保留来源并记录缺失值。扩大采集前先检查样本成本与输出。

items.title: 先搜索再打开大量网页
items.description: 针对调查问题先用搜索入口寻找来源，再检查限定数量页面。返回查询、选定 URL 与支持事实，不把搜索摘要直接当作已验证正文。

items.title: 操作云端浏览器
items.description: 交互确需浏览器时，使用对应 Bright Data 浏览器服务与已配置 Agent 工具，明确会话及预期状态并验收动作。普通获取任务不能称为已执行交互流程。

items.title: 比较现成数据与重新采集
items.description: 现成数据产品可能回答问题时，先比较覆盖、新鲜度与访问条款，再决定是否重新采集。提交选择及成本影响供审阅，MCP 或 Skill 不自动授权购买。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Bright Data MCP 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 连接 Agent 前，先确认数据任务需要的服务产品、账号权限和用量预算。

items.title: 服务账号与产品权限
items.description: 通过官方引导或客户端设置配置对应 Bright Data 产品与认证。

items.title: 采集范围与费用
items.description: 大规模运行前明确样本、字段与用量限制。

faq.question: Bright Data MCP 是免费独立爬虫吗？
faq.answer: 不是。它连接 Bright Data 服务，MIT 管理连接器源码，不包含无限服务、数据购买或浏览器会话额度。

faq.question: 有官方 Skills 吗？
faq.answer: 有。brightdata/skills 提供引导和专项指令，可指导 CLI、MCP 或 SDK，但服务仍需账号与适用权限。

faq.question: 凭据应该放在哪里？
faq.answer: 使用文档中的客户端或 CLI 认证配置，不将 API 令牌放进任务、报告或版本库，服务登录可能需要用户批准。

faq.question: 每项任务都需要浏览器吗？
faq.answer: 不需要。搜索、获取、数据集和提取面向不同输出，只有确需页面状态或动作时才使用交互浏览器。

faq.question: 本地 MCP 能让任务离线吗？
faq.answer: 不能。本地连接器仍调用 Bright Data 基础设施，宿主也可能使用远程模型，需核对服务与模型的数据路径。

faq.question: 采集报告应该包含什么？
faq.answer: 记录来源 URL、获取上下文、所需字段、缺失项及相关用量，先对照来源抽查，不能把返回 JSON 直接视为可信数据。

en.seoTitle: Lightpanda: Headless Browser Access Through MCP and Skills
en.seoDescription: Use Lightpanda for headless page access, extraction, and supported interactions through native MCP or official agent guidance. Check compatibility before replacing a full browser, especially for visual or layout-dependent work.
en.description: Use Lightpanda for headless page access, extraction, and supported interactions through native MCP or official agent guidance. Check compatibility before replacing a full browser, especially for visual or layout-dependent work.
overview: Lightpanda is a headless browser designed for AI and automation. It provides native interfaces including MCP and an official agent Skill repository. Its purpose is browser execution and page access; it is not a general-purpose desktop browser with the same visual behavior as Chrome.

The native MCP supports structured browsing actions and session handling. The official Skill describes platform-specific installation and use, including Windows through WSL2. Verify the APIs and page features needed by the task before choosing it for a site that depends on a full browser engine.

The browser repository is AGPL-3.0, while the separate agent-skill repository uses its own license. Avoid copying Chrome benchmark expectations to a different engine. Local execution, telemetry configuration, and the host model’s processing are separate choices and should be checked before handling private data.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Lightpanda Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: Lightpanda supplies a headless engine and native agent interfaces. Choose it by required page compatibility, content output, and supported platform, rather than assuming every full-browser workflow transfers without changes.

capabilities.title: Native MCP browsing
capabilities.description: Expose supported browser actions directly to an MCP host rather than relying on an unofficial wrapper.

capabilities.title: Headless extraction workflow
capabilities.description: Read supported page structures and content for data-oriented tasks without using a desktop browser window.

capabilities.title: Official installation guidance
capabilities.description: Use the separate agent Skill to select the supported binary and interface for the operating system.

useCases.title: Lightpanda Use Cases
useCases.description: The tasks below compare content extraction and runtime suitability while keeping visual QA outside the headless evidence boundary. Check representative pages before replacing a browser backend in an existing agent workflow.

items.title: Collect text from compatible pages
items.description: Start with a small set of public pages and identify the text fields needed downstream. Fetch them through the selected Lightpanda interface, compare samples with a full browser, and record unsupported features instead of silently filling gaps with inferred text.

items.title: Evaluate a lightweight browser backend
items.description: Run the same read-only task with representative pages before changing your agent infrastructure. Record compatibility, output, and the resources measured in your environment. Upstream speed comparisons are a hypothesis for your deployment, not a substitute for equivalent task results.

items.title: Connect an agent over native MCP
items.description: Configure the native server and inspect the available tools from the host. Verify a public page and one supported interaction, keeping session identifiers consistent. If a page requires unsupported behavior, report that boundary before attempting to replace the task with a different engine.

items.title: Distinguish text checks from visual QA
items.description: For a UI change, use extracted text to verify labels or content availability, then use a full rendering browser for layout assertions. Keep the two evidence sources separate so successful extraction is not misreported as a verified responsive or pixel-level result.

prerequisites.title: Before Using Lightpanda
prerequisites.description: Check the deployment platform and page requirements before choosing Lightpanda as the browser engine.

items.title: Supported system
items.description: Choose the documented binary for Linux or macOS, or the WSL2 path on Windows, and verify required page features.

items.title: Engine and Skill licenses
items.description: Review the AGPL-3.0 engine separately from the official Skill package and any hosted offering.

faq.question: Is Lightpanda a full Chrome replacement?
faq.answer: Do not assume equivalent compatibility or rendering. Check the browser’s supported features against your actual pages, and use a full browser for work that depends on visual layout.

faq.question: Does it have an official MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. The browser documents native MCP interfaces and session behavior. Use the current documentation for transport and tool options rather than assuming a community bridge is necessary.

faq.question: Where is the official Skill?
faq.answer: The separate lightpanda-io/agent-skill repository contains installation and use guidance. Its license and instructions should be read separately from the browser engine’s repository.

faq.question: Can it run on Windows?
faq.answer: The reviewed official Skill documents Windows through WSL2, alongside Linux and macOS. Do not present that as a native Windows desktop-browser build.

faq.question: Does a local engine mean no external processing?
faq.answer: No. Review telemetry settings and the host agent’s model separately. Page observations may still be sent to a model provider even when the browser runs on your machine.

faq.question: What should a compatibility trial verify?
faq.answer: Check required page APIs, extracted values, session behavior, and any interaction the task relies on. A successful process start or connection is not sufficient evidence of compatibility.

zh.seoTitle: Lightpanda：通过 MCP 与 Skill 使用无头浏览器
zh.seoDescription: 通过原生 MCP 或官方 Agent 指引使用 Lightpanda，完成无头页面访问、提取和受支持交互。替换完整浏览器前需检查兼容性，尤其是视觉与布局相关任务。
zh.description: 通过原生 MCP 或官方 Agent 指引使用 Lightpanda，完成无头页面访问、提取和受支持交互。替换完整浏览器前需检查兼容性，尤其是视觉与布局相关任务。
zh.kind: 面向 Agent 的无头浏览器
overview: Lightpanda 是面向 AI 与自动化的无头浏览器，提供原生 MCP 等接口及官方 Agent Skill 仓库。它负责浏览器执行和页面访问，不是与 Chrome 视觉行为相同的通用桌面浏览器。
原生 MCP 支持结构化浏览动作与会话管理。官方 Skill 说明各平台安装使用，包括通过 WSL2 在 Windows 运行。网站依赖完整浏览器能力时，需先验证任务所需 API 和页面特性。
浏览器仓库采用 AGPL-3.0，独立 agent-skill 仓库有自己的许可。不同引擎不能直接套用 Chrome 测试预期。本地执行、使用统计配置与宿主模型处理需分别核对，再决定是否处理私有数据。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Lightpanda 在浏览器流程中的作用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: Lightpanda 提供无头引擎和原生 Agent 接口，应按页面兼容要求、内容输出及支持平台选择，不能假定完整浏览器流程无需改动即可迁入，也不能将文本结果视为视觉证据。

capabilities.title: 原生 MCP 浏览
capabilities.description: 直接向 MCP 宿主提供受支持浏览器动作，无需默认采用非官方包装。

capabilities.title: 无头提取流程
capabilities.description: 为数据任务读取受支持页面结构与内容，无需桌面浏览器窗口。

capabilities.title: 官方安装指引
capabilities.description: 通过独立 Agent Skill 选择适合操作系统的二进制和接口。

useCases.title: Lightpanda 使用场景
useCases.description: 以下任务比较内容提取与运行适用性，将视觉验收与无头证据分开。替换既有 Agent 流程的浏览器后端前，应先检查代表页面、必要交互与输出，明确不支持行为。

items.title: 从兼容页面收集文本
items.description: 先提供少量公开页面及下游所需文本字段，通过选定 Lightpanda 入口读取，并与完整浏览器抽样对照。遇到不支持特性时记录，不能推断补齐缺失文本。

items.title: 评估轻量浏览器后端
items.description: 更换 Agent 基础设施前，使用代表页面执行同一只读任务，记录兼容性、输出及本环境测量资源。上游速度对比只是评估线索，不能替代等价任务结果。

items.title: 通过原生 MCP 连接 Agent
items.description: 配置原生服务并从宿主检查工具，验证一个公开页及受支持交互，保持会话标识一致。页面需要不支持行为时先报告边界，再决定是否更换引擎。

items.title: 区分文本检查与视觉验收
items.description: 界面改动中可用提取文本核对标签或内容存在，再用完整渲染浏览器检查布局。两类证据需分开，不能把提取成功写成响应式或像素级验收通过。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Lightpanda 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 选择 Lightpanda 作为浏览器引擎前，先检查部署平台与页面所需功能。

items.title: 支持的系统
items.description: 按文档选择 Linux、macOS 二进制或 Windows WSL2 路径，并核对所需页面特性。

items.title: 引擎与 Skill 许可
items.description: 分别核对 AGPL-3.0 引擎、官方 Skill 包及托管服务条款。

faq.question: Lightpanda 能完整替代 Chrome 吗？
faq.answer: 不能假定兼容与渲染等价。需按实际页面核对支持特性，依赖视觉布局的工作应使用完整浏览器。

faq.question: 有官方 MCP 吗？
faq.answer: 有。浏览器提供原生 MCP 文档和会话行为说明，传输及工具选项按当前文档配置，不必默认使用社区桥接。

faq.question: 官方 Skill 在哪里？
faq.answer: 独立 lightpanda-io/agent-skill 仓库提供安装和使用指引，许可及说明需与浏览器引擎仓库分别阅读。

faq.question: Windows 可以运行吗？
faq.answer: 当前官方 Skill 说明 Windows 通过 WSL2 使用，另支持 Linux 和 macOS，不能写成原生 Windows 桌面浏览器。

faq.question: 本地引擎意味着没有外部处理吗？
faq.answer: 不意味着。使用统计设置与宿主模型需分别检查，即使浏览器本地运行，页面观察仍可能发送给模型提供方。

faq.question: 兼容性试运行需要验证什么？
faq.answer: 检查所需页面 API、提取值、会话行为与依赖交互。进程启动或连接成功不足以证明页面兼容。

label.zh: 官方服务与 MCP 指南

en.seoTitle: Crawl4AI: Turn Web Pages into Structured Agent Inputs
en.seoDescription: Collect page content for research or data processing through Crawl4AI’s Python, deployed API, or documented MCP interface. Define the crawl boundary and validate extracted fields before using the data.
en.description: Collect page content for research or data processing through Crawl4AI’s Python, deployed API, or documented MCP interface. Define the crawl boundary and validate extracted fields before using the data.
overview: Crawl4AI is a web crawling and extraction framework for producing usable content from pages. Its focus is collected text and structured output rather than operating an entire business workflow on a person’s behalf. Select the pages and output contract before choosing extraction settings.

Developers can use the Python library, while deployed server interfaces provide API and MCP access for agents. The official Docker guide describes MCP use by coding agents. A server must be prepared before connecting that endpoint; a client entry does not run the whole crawler backend.

The repository is Apache-2.0. Browser rendering, network access, and any model-based extraction have their own resource and credential requirements. The main repository does not document an official end-user Skill; community Skills must be labeled by their actual maintainer rather than presented as upstream instructions.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Crawl4AI Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: Treat crawling as a data-production step. Choose pages, fields, extraction method, and server interface together, then validate a small sample before those values become inputs to another agent or report.

capabilities.title: Content-oriented crawling
capabilities.description: Choose a bounded set of pages and produce text suitable for downstream research or processing.

capabilities.title: Structured extraction
capabilities.description: Define the fields and extraction method, then check missing or malformed values before reuse.

capabilities.title: Agent-facing server access
capabilities.description: Use the documented deployed API or MCP after preparing the crawler runtime.

useCases.title: Crawl4AI Use Cases
useCases.description: Research corpora, comparison tables, documentation refreshes, and MCP extraction have different completeness checks. Keep crawl failures distinguishable from empty source values, and preserve provenance before widening the collection.

items.title: Build a sourced research corpus
items.description: Provide the allowed domains, seed URLs, and content sections needed for a research question. Collect a bounded sample and preserve the source for each document. Inspect repeated navigation and missing text before treating the corpus as sufficient evidence for a report.

items.title: Extract a product comparison table
items.description: Specify required fields and several representative product pages. Choose an extraction method suited to the page structure, validate the output shape, and compare sampled values with the rendered source. Report unavailable fields rather than inferring values from adjacent products.

items.title: Refresh documentation inputs
items.description: For a defined documentation section, collect the requested pages and compare the resulting content with a prior snapshot supplied by the user. Keep URLs and retrieval context so additions and deletions can be reviewed without confusing crawler omissions with upstream changes.

items.title: Supply structured data through MCP
items.description: Connect the host to a prepared Crawl4AI server and run one small extraction. Return the requested fields with source and failure information, then decide whether to widen the job. A successful MCP connection does not validate either the crawl boundary or the data quality.

prerequisites.title: Before Using Crawl4AI
prerequisites.description: Choose the official hosted MCP or a self-hosted crawler, then prepare the credentials and dependencies required by that deployment.

items.title: Crawler runtime
items.description: Prepare the Python or documented Docker/server environment, browser dependencies, and endpoint access.

items.title: Output contract
items.description: Define allowed URLs, page limits, fields, and a sample-validation method before a batch.

faq.question: Is Crawl4AI primarily a browser task agent?
faq.answer: Its main role is crawling and extraction for downstream data use. It may render or interact with pages as part of collection, but that is different from promising arbitrary authenticated business workflows.

faq.question: Which interface should an external agent use?
faq.answer: Use the documented server API or MCP when a crawler service is prepared; use the Python library when building a maintained application. Keep deployment prerequisites with the selected path.

faq.question: Is model-based extraction mandatory?
faq.answer: Choose the extraction method according to the content and required fields. Model-assisted extraction has separate configuration and cost; do not assume every crawl needs an LLM key.

faq.question: Is there a confirmed official Skill?
faq.answer: Use the upstream library and server documentation; the main repository does not document an official end-user Skill. Community Skill wrappers remain separate sources with their own maintainers.

faq.question: How should the crawl be limited?
faq.answer: Specify seed URLs, allowed sites, page limits, required content, and output fields before running. Inspect a sample before broadening collection so navigation loops and irrelevant pages are caught early.

faq.question: What makes the output ready for an agent?
faq.answer: Keep source URLs, check required fields, flag missing content, and distinguish extraction errors from actual empty values. Well-formed Markdown or JSON is only the format, not proof of factual completeness.

zh.seoTitle: Crawl4AI：将网页转换为结构化 Agent 输入
zh.seoDescription: 通过 Crawl4AI 的 Python、部署 API 或文档中的 MCP 接口收集页面内容，用于调查与数据处理；先限定抓取范围，再验证提取字段。
zh.description: 通过 Crawl4AI 的 Python、部署 API 或文档中的 MCP 接口收集页面内容，用于调查与数据处理；先限定抓取范围，再验证提取字段。
overview: Crawl4AI 是从网页生成可用内容的抓取和提取框架，重点是文本与结构化输出，而不是代表用户完成整项业务流程。应先确定页面和输出要求，再选择提取设置。
开发者可使用 Python 库，已部署服务则提供 API 和 MCP 供 Agent 调用。官方 Docker 指南说明编码 Agent 的 MCP 使用方式，连接前需要准备服务端，客户端条目不替代抓取后端。
仓库采用 Apache-2.0。浏览器渲染、网络访问及模型提取有各自资源和凭据要求。当前未在主仓确认官方用户 Skill，社区 Skill 需按真实维护者标明，不能作为上游官方指引。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Crawl4AI 在浏览器流程中的作用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 将抓取作为数据生产步骤，同时选择页面、字段、提取方法与服务接口。先验证小样本，再将数值交给其他 Agent 或报告，并记录来源、遗漏及无法解析的情况。

capabilities.title: 面向内容的抓取
capabilities.description: 选择限定页面集合，输出适合后续调查或处理的文本。

capabilities.title: 结构化提取
capabilities.description: 定义字段与提取方式，复用前检查缺失或格式错误。

capabilities.title: 面向 Agent 的服务接入
capabilities.description: 准备抓取运行环境后，使用文档中的部署 API 或 MCP。

useCases.title: Crawl4AI 使用场景
useCases.description: 研究语料、比较表、文档更新与 MCP 提取各有完整性检查。需区分抓取失败和来源空值，保留出处后再扩大采集，避免格式正确的文本或对象掩盖实际遗漏。

items.title: 建立有来源的研究语料
items.description: 提供允许域名、起始 URL 与调查所需内容区块，先收集有限样本并保留每份文档来源。检查重复导航和缺失正文，再判断语料是否足以支持报告。

items.title: 提取产品比较表
items.description: 指定字段及代表产品页面，按结构选择提取方式，校验输出并对照渲染来源抽查。无法取得的字段应标明，不从相邻产品推断补值。

items.title: 更新文档输入
items.description: 对明确文档区域收集指定页面，与用户提供的旧快照比较，保留 URL 及获取上下文，让新增和删除可审阅，避免把抓取遗漏当成上游改动。

items.title: 通过 MCP 提供结构化数据
items.description: 将宿主连接到准备好的 Crawl4AI 服务，先执行一次小规模提取，返回字段、来源和失败信息，再决定是否扩大任务。MCP 连通不等于范围和数据质量已合格。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Crawl4AI 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 先选择官方托管 MCP 或自部署爬取服务，再准备对应的认证与依赖。

items.title: 抓取运行环境
items.description: 准备 Python 或文档中的 Docker／服务环境、浏览器依赖及端点访问。

items.title: 输出要求
items.description: 批量前定义允许 URL、页面限制、字段及抽样验证方法。

faq.question: Crawl4AI 主要是浏览器任务 Agent 吗？
faq.answer: 主要职责是为下游数据使用抓取和提取内容。采集时可以渲染或交互，但不能据此承诺任意登录业务流程。

faq.question: 外部 Agent 应选哪个入口？
faq.answer: 已有抓取服务时可选文档中的 API 或 MCP，需要维护应用时可使用 Python 库，各路径前提应分别列明。

faq.question: 提取必须调用模型吗？
faq.answer: 按内容和字段选择提取方式。模型辅助提取有独立配置与成本，不能假定每次抓取都需要模型密钥。

faq.question: 已确认官方 Skill 吗？
faq.answer: 当前确认上游库与服务文档，未在主仓确认官方用户 Skill；社区包装属于有独立维护者的来源。

faq.question: 怎样限定抓取范围？
faq.answer: 运行前明确起始 URL、允许网站、页面限制、目标内容与字段，扩大前检查样本，尽早发现导航循环和无关页面。

faq.question: 什么样的输出适合 Agent 使用？
faq.answer: 保留来源，检查必填字段、标明缺失内容，区分提取错误和实际空值。Markdown 或 JSON 格式正确不代表事实完整。

en.seoTitle: Ego Lite: Share a Logged-In Browser with Coding Agents
en.seoDescription: Use the ego-browser Skill to let a coding agent work in its own browser Space while you keep your tabs. Ego Lite supports macOS and Windows and can reuse imported login state.
en.description: Use the ego-browser Skill to let a coding agent work in its own browser Space while you keep your tabs. Ego Lite supports macOS and Windows and can reuse imported login state.
overview: Ego Lite is CitroLabs’ Chromium-based browser for people and external coding agents. Instead of placing another assistant inside the page, ego-browser connects the agent you already use to the browser. The official instructions name Cursor, Codex, and other shell-capable hosts.

A Space groups the tabs used by an agent task while you keep browsing elsewhere. Imported Chrome data can supply existing login state, but the selected account and session still need review. Spaces separate task activity; they should not be described as a guarantee of complete security isolation.

Follow the macOS or Windows onboarding and official ego-browser Skill for the browser version you install. Keep browser execution separate from the host model’s processing of page content. The GitHub tooling uses MIT licensing; that alone does not establish the license or distribution terms of every bundled browser component.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Ego Lite Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: The shared browser, task Spaces, and ego-browser connection have different roles. Confirm the account and browser version before handing a task to an external agent, even when login state was imported successfully.

capabilities.title: Agent task Spaces
capabilities.description: Keep an agent’s task tabs organized separately from the tabs you are actively using.

capabilities.title: Existing login context
capabilities.description: Use an imported browser setup after confirming the account and permitted sites.

capabilities.title: Official connection Skill
capabilities.description: ego-browser supplies the instructions and connection layer for external coding agents.

useCases.title: Ego Lite Use Cases
useCases.description: Ego Lite is relevant when browser continuity matters: signed-in work, parallel research, draft forms, or authenticated testing. A task Space organizes activity without deciding which account actions are authorized.

items.title: Read a signed-in work portal
items.description: On an approved account, name the portal section and report fields. Let the agent work in its Space and return a sourced summary while you keep your own tabs. Confirm the account first so imported session data does not silently select the wrong workspace.

items.title: Run research beside daily browsing
items.description: Give an agent a bounded set of public pages and a comparison question. Keep its research tabs in a task Space and inspect citations in the output. Separate the task’s evidence from unrelated tabs rather than exposing the whole browsing session as context.

items.title: Prepare a form for human review
items.description: Provide an approved test page and exact values for a draft. Let the agent fill the fields in its task Space and show the resulting state, then take over for review. Keep the submit action outside the agent’s scope until you explicitly authorize it.

items.title: Check an authenticated web application
items.description: Use a dedicated test account for an application that cannot be checked anonymously. Ask the agent to reproduce one navigation or validation issue, preserving the session context and observed state. Report the exact failing path rather than treating login access as test coverage.

prerequisites.title: Before Using Ego Lite
prerequisites.description: Prepare the browser, the external-agent Skill, and the intended account before handing over a task Space.

items.title: macOS or Windows onboarding
items.description: Install the supported Ego Lite build and complete browser onboarding before connecting the Skill.

items.title: Approved login state
items.description: Check the imported profile and the account in the task Space; avoid unrelated personal data.

faq.question: Is Ego Lite a plugin or a browser?
faq.answer: It is a Chromium-based browser; ego-browser is the Skill and connection layer used by external agents. Installing only the Skill does not replace browser onboarding.

faq.question: Which platforms does Ego Lite support?
faq.answer: The official README lists macOS and Windows; Linux is on the roadmap. Choose a current build for your system and follow its onboarding before connecting an agent.

faq.question: Do Spaces create separate accounts?
faq.answer: Do not assume that. Spaces organize task tabs; existing login state may be shared by the configured browser. Inspect the active account and application workspace before operating.

faq.question: Can Floatboat use ego-browser?
faq.answer: Use the documented shell-capable agent path with the installed browser and official Skill. The connection does not mean Ego Lite is bundled with Floatboat or supported on every operating system.

faq.question: Does local browser data stay away from the model?
faq.answer: Browser storage and agent inference are different. The host may send page observations to its model provider, so local bookmarks or cookies do not imply local-only task processing.

faq.question: Are published speed comparisons a guarantee?
faq.answer: No. The upstream benchmarks use particular agents, tasks, and grading conditions. Compare your own task and model before expecting the same relative speed or success rate.

zh.seoTitle: Ego Lite：与编码 Agent 共用已登录的浏览器
zh.seoDescription: 通过 ego-browser Skill，让编码 Agent 在任务 Space 工作，你继续使用自己的标签页。Ego Lite 支持 macOS 和 Windows，可复用导入的登录状态。
zh.description: 通过 ego-browser Skill，让编码 Agent 在任务 Space 工作，你继续使用自己的标签页。Ego Lite 支持 macOS 和 Windows，可复用导入的登录状态。
zh.kind: 人机共用 Agent 浏览器
overview: Ego Lite 是 CitroLabs 面向用户和外部编码 Agent 的 Chromium 浏览器。ego-browser 将现有 Agent 连接到浏览器，官方指引列明 Cursor、Codex 及其他能运行命令的宿主。
Space 将 Agent 任务使用的标签页组织在一起，你可继续在别处浏览。导入的 Chrome 数据可提供登录状态，但仍需核对账号与会话。Space 用于区分任务活动，不能直接称为完整安全隔离保证。
按所安装版本完成 macOS 或 Windows 引导并使用官方 ego-browser Skill。浏览器运行位置与宿主模型处理页面内容需分别考虑。GitHub 工具采用 MIT 许可，但这不能代表所有捆绑浏览器组件的许可和分发条款。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: Ego Lite 在浏览器流程中的作用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 共用浏览器、任务 Space 和 ego-browser 连接承担不同职责。即使登录状态已导入，也需核对账号与浏览器版本，再将范围明确的任务交给外部 Agent。

capabilities.title: Agent 任务 Space
capabilities.description: 将 Agent 任务标签页与自己正在使用的标签页分开组织。

capabilities.title: 既有登录上下文
capabilities.description: 导入浏览器配置后，核对账号与获准网站再使用。

capabilities.title: 官方连接 Skill
capabilities.description: ego-browser 提供外部编码 Agent 的指引和连接层。

useCases.title: Ego Lite 使用场景
useCases.description: 需要延续浏览器状态时，可考虑登录工作、并行调查、表单草稿或登录测试。Space 组织任务活动，但不会替代账号权限决定，仍需明确操作范围与验收结果。

items.title: 读取已登录工作门户
items.description: 在获准账号中明确门户区域与报告字段，让 Agent 在自己的 Space 整理带来源摘要，你继续使用自己的标签页。先核对账号，避免导入会话误选工作区。

items.title: 在日常浏览旁开展调查
items.description: 提供一组公开页面和比较问题，将调查标签页放进任务 Space，并检查输出引用。任务证据与无关标签页分开，不把整个浏览会话都当作上下文。

items.title: 准备人工审阅的表单
items.description: 提供获准测试页面与草稿字段值，让 Agent 在任务 Space 填写并展示状态，再由你接手审阅。提交动作在明确授权前不属于本次操作范围。

items.title: 检查登录后的 Web 应用
items.description: 对无法匿名检查的应用使用专用测试账号，让 Agent 复现一处导航或校验问题，保留会话上下文与实际状态。交付确切失败路径，登录可用不等于测试覆盖完整。

prerequisites.title: 使用 Ego Lite 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 将任务交给 Agent Space 前，先准备浏览器、外部 Agent Skill 及实际使用的账号。

items.title: macOS 或 Windows 引导
items.description: 安装受支持的 Ego Lite 版本，完成浏览器引导后再连接 Skill。

items.title: 获准登录状态
items.description: 检查导入配置与任务 Space 中的账号，避免涉及无关个人数据。

faq.question: Ego Lite 是插件还是浏览器？
faq.answer: 它是 Chromium 浏览器，ego-browser 是供外部 Agent 使用的 Skill 与连接层，单独安装 Skill 不替代浏览器引导。

faq.question: Ego Lite 支持哪些平台？
faq.answer: 官方 README 列出 macOS 和 Windows，Linux 仍在路线图中。应选择适配系统的当前版本，完成浏览器引导后再连接 Agent。

faq.question: Space 会创建独立账号吗？
faq.answer: 不能这样假定。Space 组织任务标签页，登录状态可能来自同一浏览器配置；操作前需检查活跃账号和应用工作区。

faq.question: Floatboat 能使用 ego-browser 吗？
faq.answer: 可按能执行命令的 Agent 路径使用已安装浏览器和官方 Skill；这不表示 Floatboat 捆绑 Ego Lite 或支持所有操作系统。

faq.question: 本地浏览器数据不会发给模型吗？
faq.answer: 浏览器存储与 Agent 推理不同，宿主可能把页面观察发送给模型，本地书签或 Cookie 不意味着整项任务只在本机处理。

faq.question: 公布的速度对比是效果保证吗？
faq.answer: 不是。上游测试使用特定 Agent、任务与评分条件，应以自己的任务和模型验证，不能直接套用速度或成功率。

en.seoTitle: BrowserOS: Connect Coding Agents to a Browser over Local MCP
en.seoDescription: Use BrowserOS neo’s local MCP endpoint from Floatboat or another MCP host. Keep the browser product, the external-agent connection, and the official browseros-neo Skill in one workflow.
en.description: Use BrowserOS neo’s local MCP endpoint from Floatboat or another MCP host. Keep the browser product, the external-agent connection, and the official browseros-neo Skill in one workflow.
overview: BrowserOS is an agentic browser project, and its neo documentation exposes a local MCP server for external AI tools. The connection page explicitly lists Cursor and Codex alongside other clients. This external-tool path is distinct from asking the browser’s own built-in assistant to do a task.

Open the MCP panel in the installed browser to obtain its current endpoint. Supported clients have connection helpers; other MCP hosts can use the displayed URL. A local endpoint describes the browser connection, not where the host agent’s language model runs or how it processes page content.

The official browseros-neo Skill supplies instructions for that browser surface. Keep it aligned with the installed BrowserOS generation rather than combining older extension instructions with neo configuration. The source repository is AGPL-3.0; review distribution obligations separately from ordinary task use.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How BrowserOS Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: Start from the endpoint shown by the installed BrowserOS generation. Client connection helpers and the official Skill support that interface; neither changes the selected model or grants access to an arbitrary account.

capabilities.title: Local MCP endpoint
capabilities.description: Read the browser’s displayed endpoint and configure an external MCP client against it.

capabilities.title: Client connection helpers
capabilities.description: The neo connection guide lists supported agent hosts and a manual path for other MCP clients.

capabilities.title: Browser-specific guidance
capabilities.description: Use the official browseros-neo Skill with the matching browser generation.

useCases.title: BrowserOS Use Cases
useCases.description: An external-agent connection is useful for repository checks and account-specific pages, while some jobs fit the browser’s own interface. Compare where the work belongs and keep handoff state explicit.

items.title: Connect an existing coding workflow
items.description: When the repository agent needs to inspect a web change, connect it to the endpoint shown by BrowserOS neo. Verify a public page title before opening the local application, then check one control and return the observed state alongside the relevant code question.

items.title: Inspect an account-specific page
items.description: Choose an approved test account inside the browser and define the permitted page. Ask the external agent for a read-only summary of specified fields, recording the active account and source. MCP connectivity alone does not authorize changes to that account.

items.title: Compare a browser-native and external agent
items.description: Use the same small website task to decide whether the work belongs in the browser or in a repository conversation. Compare the output and evidence, not only the interface. Keep each task’s model and connection configuration recorded so the comparison is interpretable.

items.title: Prepare a human handoff
items.description: Let the agent inspect a form or application state without completing a consequential action. Return the current page, selected values, and outstanding confirmation so a person can review the task in the browser. Verify the visible state before continuing after a handoff.

prerequisites.title: Before Using BrowserOS
prerequisites.description: Match the installed browser generation to its MCP configuration and confirm which profile the external agent will use.

items.title: Matching BrowserOS generation
items.description: Use a supported BrowserOS neo build and read its MCP panel; do not rely on legacy extension instructions.

items.title: External client configuration
items.description: Configure the displayed endpoint in the selected host and verify a public page before using private sessions.

faq.question: Is BrowserOS only a built-in assistant?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed neo documentation provides a local MCP endpoint for external tools, explicitly including Cursor and Codex. That path is the basis for the Floatboat use case here.

faq.question: Where should I copy the endpoint from?
faq.answer: Open the installed browser’s MCP panel and use the displayed address. Follow its connection instructions rather than assuming a fixed port will be correct on every installation.

faq.question: Does local MCP imply local inference?
faq.answer: No. The MCP server connects the agent to the browser on the machine; the agent’s model may still run remotely. Assess page content and model configuration separately.

faq.question: Is there an official Skill?
faq.answer: The BrowserOS repository includes browseros-neo instructions. Use that Skill with the corresponding browser version; it is not a separate browser download or an independent product.

faq.question: Should the old and neo setup be mixed?
faq.answer: Follow one documented generation. Client entries, extension behavior, and endpoint choices may differ; verify the installed version before copying a configuration from an older tutorial.

faq.question: What confirms the agent is connected correctly?
faq.answer: List the available tools, open one harmless public page, and compare its title or content with the browser. A configuration file being written is not sufficient proof of a working connection.

zh.description: 通过 BrowserOS neo 的本地 MCP 端点连接 Floatboat 或其他 MCP 宿主，操作网页并检查结果。官方 browseros-neo Skill 提供相应的浏览器任务指引。
zh.kind: 带本地 MCP 的 Agent 浏览器
overview: BrowserOS 是 Agent 浏览器项目，其 neo 文档为外部 AI 工具提供本地 MCP 服务。连接页明确列出 Cursor、Codex 等客户端，这条路径与使用浏览器内置助手不同。
在已安装浏览器的 MCP 面板取得当前端点。支持的客户端有连接辅助，其他 MCP 宿主可使用显示的 URL。本地端点只说明浏览器连接位置，不代表宿主模型在本机运行。
官方 browseros-neo Skill 提供对应浏览器入口的指引，应与实际 BrowserOS 代际匹配，不能把旧扩展说明和 neo 配置混用。源码仓采用 AGPL-3.0，分发义务与日常任务使用需分别核对。
zh.capabilitiesTitle: BrowserOS 在浏览器流程中的作用
zh.capabilitiesIntro: 从所安装 BrowserOS 代际显示的端点开始，结合客户端连接辅助与官方 Skill 使用对应接口。连接不改变选定模型，也不自动授权访问任意账号，需要核对实际会话。

capabilities.title: 本地 MCP 端点
capabilities.description: 读取浏览器显示的端点，将外部 MCP 客户端连接到该地址。

capabilities.title: 客户端连接辅助
capabilities.description: neo 连接指南列出支持的宿主，并提供其他 MCP 客户端的手动路径。

capabilities.title: 浏览器专属指引
capabilities.description: 为匹配代际的浏览器使用官方 browseros-neo Skill。

useCases.title: BrowserOS 使用场景
useCases.description: 外部 Agent 连接适合仓库检查及账号专属页面，另一些任务可在浏览器自身界面完成。以下场景帮助判断工作入口，并在人工接手时保留明确状态和下一步。

items.title: 连接现有编码工作流
items.description: 仓库 Agent 需要检查网页改动时，连接 BrowserOS neo 显示的端点。先用公开页标题验证连接，再打开本地应用，检查一个控件并将状态与代码问题对应。

items.title: 检查账号专属页面
items.description: 在浏览器选择获准测试账号并限定页面，让外部 Agent 只读整理指定字段，记录活跃账号与来源。MCP 连接成功并不授权修改账号内容。

items.title: 比较内置与外部 Agent 流程
items.description: 用同一小型网站任务判断工作适合在浏览器还是仓库对话中完成。比较输出和证据，不只看界面；记录各任务的模型与连接配置，让比较有明确含义。

items.title: 准备人工接手
items.description: 让 Agent 检查表单或应用状态，暂不执行关键动作，返回当前页面、已选值和待确认事项，供用户在浏览器审阅。接手后继续之前，再核对可见状态。

prerequisites.title: 使用 BrowserOS 前的准备
prerequisites.description: 将已安装浏览器代际与 MCP 配置对应，并确认外部 Agent 将使用的配置和账号。

items.title: 匹配 BrowserOS 代际
items.description: 使用支持的 BrowserOS neo 版本并查看 MCP 面板，不依赖旧扩展配置。

items.title: 外部客户端配置
items.description: 在宿主配置显示的端点，先验证公开页，再使用私有会话。

faq.question: BrowserOS 只有内置助手吗？
faq.answer: 不是。neo 文档提供外部工具使用的本地 MCP 端点，明确列出 Cursor、Codex，本页据此说明 Floatboat 使用路径。

faq.question: 从哪里复制端点？
faq.answer: 从已安装浏览器的 MCP 面板复制显示地址并按说明连接，不假定每台安装都使用固定端口。

faq.question: 本地 MCP 就是本地推理吗？
faq.answer: 不是。本地 MCP 将 Agent 连接到电脑中的浏览器，模型仍可能远程运行，需另行检查页面内容与模型配置。

faq.question: 有官方 Skill 吗？
faq.answer: BrowserOS 仓库包含 browseros-neo 指引，应匹配浏览器版本使用；它不是单独浏览器下载，也不是另一产品。

faq.question: 旧版配置能和 neo 混用吗？
faq.answer: 应遵循同一代际文档。客户端条目、扩展行为和端点可能不同，复制旧教程配置前先核对安装版本。

faq.question: 怎样确认 Agent 连接正确？
faq.answer: 先确认工具列表，再打开无敏感内容的公开页，对照浏览器中的标题或正文。配置文件写入成功不等于连接可用。

en.seoTitle: Browser MCP: Let Coding Agents Use Your Own Chrome Tabs
en.seoDescription: Connect a local MCP server and Chrome extension so an agent can use your existing browser profile. Pair the extension deliberately, then work in task tabs with the selected account.
en.description: Connect a local MCP server and Chrome extension so an agent can use your existing browser profile. Pair the extension deliberately, then work in task tabs with the selected account.
overview: Browser MCP provides an MCP server and extension for using your own Chrome from an AI application. The README names Cursor, Codex, and other clients. It is useful when a task depends on an existing browser profile rather than an unrelated automation browser.

A local daemon forwards browser calls through the extension, which requires a pairing confirmation. The documented design gives agents their own task tabs and retains extension-side controls such as stopping activity. Confirm the pairing code and selected profile before granting access.

The repository uses Apache-2.0 and provides an MCP server and browser extension. It relies on the connected agent for task planning. Existing login state does not remove account permissions, and local browser execution does not determine how the host model processes page content.
en.capabilitiesTitle: How Browser MCP Fits the Browser Workflow
en.capabilitiesIntro: Pair the official extension with its local server, choose the intended profile, and verify task tabs before reading account data. The connection layer supplies access; the host still decides and checks each action.

capabilities.title: Use a real Chrome profile
capabilities.description: Operate approved signed-in pages through the extension instead of rebuilding every login in a fresh browser.

capabilities.title: Local pairing and relay
capabilities.description: Check the displayed pairing code before allowing the extension to relay agent commands.

capabilities.title: Task-tab operation
capabilities.description: Keep the agent’s browser work in its task tabs and use the extension’s stop control when necessary.

useCases.title: Browser MCP Use Cases
useCases.description: Existing Chrome state is helpful for portal reports and profile-specific issues. The following tasks keep that continuity while separating draft preparation, read-only collection, and review of agent tab activity.

items.title: Collect a portal status report
items.description: After pairing the approved Chrome profile, ask the agent to read a named report section. Capture the active account, period, and selected fields, then return a traceable summary. Avoid treating every page visible in your personal profile as part of the task.

items.title: Check a profile-dependent bug
items.description: When a bug occurs only in the existing profile, reproduce the specified interaction through the extension rather than switching immediately to a fresh browser. Record the relevant state and keep unrelated extensions or tabs out of the investigation until they are needed.

items.title: Prepare values in an authenticated form
items.description: Provide exact draft values and a clear stopping point. Have the agent fill the form in a task tab and report the visible validation state. The person reviewing the browser can then decide whether to submit; the extension connection does not grant blanket write approval.

items.title: Review task-tab activity
items.description: For a shared browsing session, ask the agent to name the pages it touched and summarize the observed result. Use the extension stop control if scope changes unexpectedly, then inspect the task tabs before resuming. A clean tool response cannot replace checking the actual pages.

prerequisites.title: Before Using Browser MCP
prerequisites.description: Prepare the intended Chrome profile, extension pairing, and client connection before granting browser access.

items.title: Chrome extension
items.description: Install the official extension in the intended Chrome profile and keep its controls available.

items.title: MCP server and pairing
items.description: Prepare the documented Node runtime, connect the MCP package, and approve the matching local pairing code.

faq.question: Is this Microsoft’s Playwright MCP?
faq.answer: No. Browser MCP is a separate project with its own MCP package, daemon, and Chrome extension. Both can automate pages, but their setup and browser-session model differ.

faq.question: Must I install both parts?
faq.answer: The documented real-browser workflow uses the MCP server and Chrome extension together. A client configuration alone does not provide the extension or complete the pairing step.

faq.question: How is pairing approved?
faq.answer: Follow the extension popup and compare the displayed code with the agent’s code before allowing the connection. Do not approve an unexpected pairing merely because the extension is installed.

faq.question: Can it access incognito or internal pages?
faq.answer: The extension enforces its documented restrictions. Incognito requires an explicit browser setting, and internal browser/extension pages are restricted; do not promise arbitrary-page access.

faq.question: Does it have an official Skill?
faq.answer: Use the official server, extension, and MCP documentation. The main repository does not document an official end-user Skill installation.

faq.question: Does my model see the whole profile?
faq.answer: The agent receives the browser data exposed through its tool use. Scope the task and selected tabs carefully; using a local relay does not establish that observations stay away from a remote model.
